name: Justin Kwasa, LCV
subject: [Add your name]: Ask President Biden to protect our democracy
body:
Help us reach 5,000 comments to overcome corporate polluters.? Tell the EPA:
PROTECT COMMUNITIES FROM CHEMICAL DISASTERS
The EPA is now seeking public input on a new rule to require industrial facilities to disclose the hazardous chemical risks posed by their operations, take stronger actions to prevent accidents, and move quickly should an accident occur.

Corporate polluters have already killed this rule once, when Trump decided to allow these dangerous facilities to operate in secrecy. We cannot allow them to succeed again.

GOAL: 5,000 actions
TAKE ACTION https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/w_ ? ?
? Peter ? a critical new rule from Biden's EPA would finally require dangerous industrial facilities to disclose any hazardous chemicals they contain ? and take steps to prevent and mitigate harmful accidents.

This rule will especially protect people living closest to these facilities, which are overwhelmingly low-wealth communities and communities of color, as well as workers. Decades of environmental racism ensured these hazardous facilities were located in the neighborhoods with the least resources to fight back, meaning these frontline communities are disproportionately exposed to chemical accidents and harmful pollutants that have jeopardized their health.

Here's the problem: powerful interests, like the oil and gas industry and the chemical industry, are demanding the EPA once again abandon these important protections. Unless our movement speaks up right now, we may miss out on this opportunity to advance environmental justice and worker safety, and create healthier communities and workplaces.

Please TAKE ACTION right now to protect communities from chemical hazards. To beat the chemical industry, we need to urgently deliver 5,000 comments supporting the EPA's proposed rule. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/6Lg6B~

We've already seen the dangers these facilities can pose. In 2013, an explosion of ammonium nitrate fertilizer killed 15 people and destroyed a school, nursing home, and many homes in the city of West, Texas. The Obama administration began a painstaking process to prevent similar disasters, culminating in enhanced protections for minimizing and managing chemical risks.

But after an aggressive campaign from the chemical industry and other corporate polluters, the Trump administration abandoned the rule, choosing to prioritize corporate profits over the health of vulnerable communities and workers.

Under President Biden, the EPA can now reverse this dangerous decision and finally help protect people, especially environmental justice communities, from hazardous pollution and chemical disasters.

Don't let corporate polluters undermine critical environment protections. TAKE ACTION now to help us deliver 5,000 comments supporting environmental justice and corporate accountability. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/G8bxcg-EdRF8/V1hNN2ZKZnowUCtCckgrM3hGK2krME8xMW5jWmFPTVNMbmlCNVdleHBweHdPdDV1QWhHUkhRU1Rqa20vczNNOHd2cnVvU0NnTHdsT09wL1ZaZ25jQlF3NUdvc0hmcUdPVFFXOUw3MmxISDA9S0/TnRpZVpSdDd6djlseWR1S28yNGN2dEpzei9pZDh5RGdUNmFNbGJjbmpUTDhJei9NV0tMTkx6OW9mbjhwUnJTd3NGV21vdzhHSk1vSWhGelg0b2ZmZDBIVzhkaDlyR0o0Sktpc09sTEJFSG89S0

Thank you for taking action to protect people and workers from environmental disasters.

Sincerely,

Madeleine Foote
Deputy Legislative Director
League of Conservation Voters ? ? ? ? ? This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Ritchie Torres represents the future of the Democratic Party. Raised by a single mother in public housing, Ritchie personally understands the hardships that working families endure. At age 25, Ritchie made history as the youngest elected official to serve on the New York City Council. He fought tirelessly for the working families of The Bronx, and now, he's fighting for those families and for progressive values in Congress. **GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

Bill grew up in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and is a proud LSU graduate. He worked in Louisiana’s charity hospital system for over 25 years, ensuring that the less fortunate in our state were able to receive quality health care. Later, Bill co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic, providing free dental and health care to working families without insurance. In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility.
As a conservative in the Senate, he focuses on the issues Louisiana families care about the most. Bill is working to lower the cost of health care, make flood insurance affordable, and save Social Security from a 24% cut if Washington fails to act.
Bill, and his wife, Laura, live in Baton Rouge and attend church at the Chapel on the Campus. They are blessed with three children and one grandchild.

For Louisiana, Team Cassidy | "Facebook" | "Twitter" | "Instagram" | "LinkedIn" ---|---|---|--- Bill grew up in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and is a proud LSU graduate. He worked in Louisiana’s charity hospital system for over 25 years, ensuring that the less fortunate in our state were able to receive quality health care. Later, Bill co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic, providing free dental and health care to working families without insurance. In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility. As a conservative in the Senate, he focuses on the issues Louisiana families care about the most. Bill is working to lower the cost of health care, make flood insurance affordable, and save Social Security from a 24% cut if Washington fails to act. Bill, and his wife, Laura, live in Baton Rouge and attend church at the Chapel on the Campus. * Anti-abortion

On January 13, the Republic of China (also known as Taiwan) will hold its next presidential election. The outcome of that election will impact Taipei's relationship with Beijing and could lead to a material change in the nature of cross-strait relations. It very well may determine whether or not China decides to militarily "reintegrate" the island nation. And while the stakes are obviously high for those who reside in Taiwan, the ripples from the Taiwan Strait will be felt globally.
To successfully navigate the election uncertainty, it's helpful to think in terms of scenarios. How will Taiwanese policy change under the various election scenarios? And perhaps more importantly, does the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) in Beijing have a preferred outcome? If so, might it inspire election interference or disinformation efforts to influence the results?
Before we dig into these scenarios, however, it is important that we understand the players involved. It's also critical to understand that Taiwanese politics has been historically dominated by two parties that differed in how they sought to interact with the People's Republic of China (PRC). This year, we have a third party as well as an individual who has opted to run as an independent. Nevertheless, notes Reuters,
> _[The issue of China, which views self-ruled Taiwan as its territory, looms over the Jan. 13 parliamentary and presidential elections. It has stepped up military and political pressure to press the island to accept its sovereignty claim, which Taiwan rejects. China cut off a routine talks with Taiwan after President Tsai Ing-wen of the DPP took office in 2016. The two opposition parties have vowed to pursue dialogue with China on an equal and dignified basis and"restore peace and stability in the Taiwan Strait."](https://substack.com/redirect/203f79a0-c4ee-40e1-8f0a-ec575c694ac4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_
## **The Players**
The incumbent political party is the **Democratic Progressive Party (DPP)** , a party that _de facto_ stands for the protection of Taiwan's independent status and views the mainland with skepticism. The public mission of the DPP is "[to further deepen Taiwan's democracy and safeguard Taiwan's democratic institutions for the Taiwanese people](https://substack.com/redirect/61449601-9dc4-41e3-a7be-dc8c73a53909?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)," but the party also refused to accept the "[1992 Consensus](https://substack.com/redirect/f5d0cd01-a5db-4545-9fff-29e47326a811?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)," an agreement made by the KMT with the CCP acknowledging there is only one China.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4375d57b-e64a-465d-b7e5-8f28b157ca88?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Taiwan's Vice President William Lai, also a presidential front-runner, delivers a speech during a press conference in Taipei, Taiwan, April 12, 2023. Source: [https://www.voanews.com/a/taiwan-vp-s-us-transit-to-test-already-tense-china-us-ties-/7191691.html](https://substack.com/redirect/e144983c-4850-4c83-be83-c4a9b95ff61e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Current Taiwan president Tsai Ing-wen leads the DPP party and is wrapping up her second term. Lai Ching-te, Tsai's current vice president, is the party's candidate in the upcoming presidential election. He is a former doctor who in 2017 called himself a "[pragmatic worker for Taiwan independence](https://substack.com/redirect/23ea0b25-8848-45fb-8790-327e1b115af1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." (In the eyes of Beijing, making such statement is tantamount to treason.) At a recent national DPP convention, Lai stated his commitment to strengthening Taiwan's defense capabilities while also expressing a willingness to engage China, but only "on an equal basis." Lai is currently leading in the polls.
**The Kuomintang (KMT)** , also known as the Nationalist Party of China, is the political group most closely aligned with the Chinese Communist Party and seeks to increase engagement with Beijing. Despite being in power on the mainland during the Republican Era (1928-1949), the party fled to the island of Taiwan on December 7, 1949 when it lost the Chinese civil war.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3ec86d17-7ee9-43dd-9823-1696afe1a696?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
New Taipei City Mayor Hou Yu-ih raises his fist during a speech following his confirmation as the presidential candidate for Taiwan's main opposition Kuomintang, at their headquarters in Taipei. Source: [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2023/05/17/asia-pacific/politics-diplomacy-asia-pacific/taiwan-kuomintang-presidential-candidate-hou-yu-ih/](https://substack.com/redirect/893b5bac-8170-4a27-a3f0-294a306fa6d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The KMT has been presented the current election as a choice between war and peace...and noted that a vote for the DPP is a vote for war. The KMT candidate for the upcoming election is Hou Yu-ih, a former police chief turned mayor of New Taipei City. Hou seeks to engage the CCP and strengthen ties between Taipei and Beijing in an effort to de-escalate tensions. Critics suggest the KMT has deep ties to the CCP and is therefore beholden to Beijing.
In 2019, a third party entered Taiwan's political scene. **The Taiwan 's People Party** **(TPP)** was formed with a basic premise: the ROC's relationship with the PRC isn't the only issue affect the citizens of Taiwan. The TPP had a marginal impact during the 2020 elections, but has recently been surging in popularity, particularly among younger voters. TPP's founder, chairman, and current candidate, Ko Wen-je, is a former doctor who served as mayor. He's vowed to unite Taiwan and is currently polling in 2nd place, behind Lai.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/024f3a6d-1cf5-4604-b28b-3edc60e4df7f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Source: [https://ketagalanmedia.com/2015/02/02/straight-talking-taipei-mayor-ko-wen-je-takes-china/](https://substack.com/redirect/7324c19d-249c-415b-bd39-e9593bca8bfa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
> _["The DPP and KMT have long been framing Taiwan's future as a choice between unification with China or safeguarding Taiwan's sovereignty," said Jack Lin, a 34-year-old engineer living in the southern Taiwanese city of Kaohsiung. Lin hopes Taiwan can let a political party with a different vision lead Taiwan amid the increasing military threats and diplomatic pressure from China. "I don't want Taiwan to keep being governed by the two main parties, so Ko is young people's hope to end this cycle. He is is the right man at the right time," he said.](https://substack.com/redirect/7f3d16e9-e095-4123-ac0d-cbf3bd2c1f09?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_
The fourth contender for the President's office is **the billionaire entrepreneur Gou Tai-ming,** founder of Foxconn, the manufacturing company that has Apple, Google and Amazon among its top clients. Gou failed to secure the KMT nomination and later opted to run as an independent, launching his campaign in August 2023. Gou needs to secure 290,000 signatures (~1.5% of the number of votes cast in the last presidential election) before November 2 to qualify as a candidate. In early October, [his campaign claimed to have achieved this objective](https://substack.com/redirect/1941d01a-27e9-4c4b-bf9a-a13f284c609d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ca2c7cf1-9f52-4cb0-a937-0e9f992d29ea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Foxconn founder Gou Tai-ming; Source:[ https://www.jsonline.com/story/money/business/2019/04/16/foxconns-terry-gou-may-run-president-taiwan/3485050002/](https://substack.com/redirect/0fc3936c-4c58-4507-873c-083f76579f7b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Gou's platform is focused on increasing trust across the Taiwan Strait with a focus on peace: "[I will never allow Taiwan to become the next Ukraine](https://substack.com/redirect/aa6c93c5-7b6a-49b4-b771-9073faa0ec3f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." He plans to do this by increasing engagement with the PRC, doubling the rate of economic growth, and making Taiwan's GDP per capita the highest in Asia. [Some have suggested that his late entry into a crowded field of pro-China candidates makes a DPP victory more likely, while other suggest his entry will spur a coalition among the TPP and KMT](https://substack.com/redirect/9f8f0b80-56a2-4e58-b525-7e4861c76a19?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
## **What to Watch**
[Recent polls suggest that the DPP is starting to lose momentum](https://substack.com/redirect/cf6a4e5b-4c87-47f8-a159-a515d02fbc5c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Although a large percentage of voters remain undecided, [Lai has seen his support drop below 30%](https://substack.com/redirect/cf6a4e5b-4c87-47f8-a159-a515d02fbc5c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Although he's still the front-runner, [the TPP's Ko Wen-je is rapidly catching up and recently polled around 26%, while KMT candidate Hou Yu-ih came in around 21%](https://substack.com/redirect/cf6a4e5b-4c87-47f8-a159-a515d02fbc5c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Simple math suggests a coalition between the KMT and TPP could dethrone DPP dominance, leading to a more Beijing-friendly government in Taipei. [While recent reports suggest a coalition is being explored, the ticket would have to be set soon, a process that includes picking who would be president and who would be vice president -- a non-trivial task](https://substack.com/redirect/203f79a0-c4ee-40e1-8f0a-ec575c694ac4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Another factor to watch is Beijing. In an [article entitled "China Is Flooding Taiwan With Disinformation,"](https://substack.com/redirect/f250bbfd-5519-4c8f-834f-a045e0b7885c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) _The Economist_ noted how Chinese efforts have ramped up to present the United States (not China) as the island's biggest threat. The article highlights a claim that America wanted to blow up Taiwan's biggest chipmaker. It was promoted via [a video featuring a US lawmaker discussing the possibility](https://substack.com/redirect/7bac914b-032e-4aa4-87fd-efd3c46b4ead?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Douyin, China's version of TikTok. [A Taiwanese paper picked up the story and it was amplified by opposition lawmakers, talk show hosts, and others](https://substack.com/redirect/f250bbfd-5519-4c8f-834f-a045e0b7885c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Another example of Chinese disinformation includes [a "leaked" report of a secret government meeting between Washington and Taipei in which America apparently asked Taiwan to start manufacturing bioweapons at a lab on the island](https://substack.com/redirect/f250bbfd-5519-4c8f-834f-a045e0b7885c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). After the story spread rapidly, it went on to suggest that the government was going to collect 150,000 samples of Taiwanese blood for the Americans to develop a virus to kill ethnic Chinese people.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/e1607f3f-657a-48e5-ad10-8c208da04ea1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Will these disinformation efforts work? It's unclear. They are all reminiscent of the CCP's efforts going into the 2020 election, when the University of Gothenburg in Sweden found that Taiwan was "[subjected to more disinformation from Beijing and other governments than anyplace in the world](https://substack.com/redirect/3fad187f-a5b4-4995-8653-25999a2808d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." While it's impossible to know how effective those efforts were, the 2019-2020 Hong Kong protests dominated headlines, leading voters concerned about China to vote for the DPP.
[China has also drastically increased its military maneuvers in the Taiwan Strait and "rehearsals" of an attack on the island. It's also increased cyber attacks and regularly violates Taiwanese airspace restrictions](https://substack.com/redirect/1d4a38e3-3a5d-4af1-81da-b47f7d28b7c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Could the CCP try to scare the population into voting for the KMT?
## So What?
**If Hou wins** , Chinese hopes for a peaceful reintegration of Taiwan rise while military tensions fall. Could it begin a process of a peaceful reunification? Given domestic weakness within the PRC, I imagine the political narratives would drift to the rear as economic topics regained center stage. Derek Grossman, a senior defense analyst at the RAND Corporation who formerly served as an intelligence adviser at the Pentagon, summarized the situation quite succinctly: "[For China, it will be the KMT's Hou or bust. If Taiwan elects Lai, this will represent another major step backward in Beijing's plans for peaceful reunification.](https://substack.com/redirect/6a2a6343-130d-4bdb-a5eb-b5fa9020d269?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" My sense is that **a TPP, Gou, or a KMT-TPP coalition victory** would also be much preferred to a DPP victory, but less desired than a KMT win.
**If Lai wins** , escalation risks increase dramatically, quite possibly leading to military conflict. Xi Jinping might find the regression away from peaceful reunification unacceptable and, with the Western world distracted by ongoing wars in Ukraine and Israel, conclude it was time to militarily reunify with Taiwan. It's possible that Chinese economic weakness, combined with Taiwanese saber-rattling, would prevent war from breaking out. _Time_ recently reported "[Taiwan's DPP leaders are looking beyond the election toward the more threatening approach from China. Their latest pushback comes in the form of a new defense report they hope will make China think harder about a future invasion](https://substack.com/redirect/84b005e9-fc94-4804-8137-09c5e52c5bcb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." [That report, released in September, called for strengthening Taiwan's asymmetric defense capabilities, including a ramp up of military drones (based on lessons fro the Russian invasion of Ukraine).](https://substack.com/redirect/0e94f14c-5d8f-4e85-a45a-2531d5c64abe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Might the report change Beijing's calculus?[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/0e94f14c-5d8f-4e85-a45a-2531d5c64abe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)Another possible impact of a Lai victory is termination of the [Economic Cooperation Framework Agreement](https://substack.com/redirect/a6fff941-e818-4fbc-a3ce-a27f5f9f36d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the free trade agreement between China and Taiwan.
**Xi Jinping might find the regression away from peaceful reunification unacceptable and, with the Western world distracted by ongoing wars in Ukraine and Israel, conclude it was time to militarily reunify with Taiwan.**
**If the election leads to war** , China will be the target of many sanctions, further impacting an already slowing domestic economy. It might even lead Chinese citizens to question the legitimacy of the CCP. Would Beijing be willing to bear this risk? Further, [Joe Biden has reiterated four times as president of the United States that he'd send American troops to protect the island if necessary](https://substack.com/redirect/6d02d939-62f6-4774-a9e1-8b80a4b6857a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which could pit two nuclear armed nations against each other. Other US and Taiwanese allies, such as Australia and Japan, might also join the conflict, massively increasing the possibility of the war spreading. And of course, an invasion of Taiwan would lead both local and global economies into a recession as overwhelming uncertainty would reduce consumer and business confidence. The semiconductor industry would be paralyzed, disrupting the entire supply chains of products that contain chips. The US dollar, gold, US treasuries and bitcoin would likely rise in value as global capital would head to safe havens.
As we rapidly approach the January election, it's important to remember ["Taiwanese voters will in effect be asked to decide whether Taiwan should remain aligned with America in strengthening deterrence against a possible Chinese invasion, or should move towards building ties with China."](https://substack.com/redirect/f250bbfd-5519-4c8f-834f-a045e0b7885c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Regardless of what they choose, economic and political ripples are likely to wash up on distant shores.

Exploring the Potential Impacts of Taiwan's Upcoming Election | | | Oct 31 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- On January 13, the Republic of China (also known as Taiwan) will hold its next presidential election. The outcome of that election will impact Taipei's relationship with Beijing and could lead to a material change in the nature of cross-strait relations. It very well may determine whether or not China decides to militarily "reintegrate" the island nation. And while the stakes are obviously high for those who reside in Taiwan, the ripples from the Taiwan Strait will be felt globally. To successfully navigate the election uncertainty, it's helpful to think in terms of scenarios. How will Taiwanese policy change under the various election scenarios? And perhaps more importantly, does the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) in Beijing have a preferred outcome? If so, might it inspire election interference or disinformation efforts to influence the results? Before we dig into these scenarios, however, it is important that we understand the players involved. It's also critical to understand that Taiwanese politics has been historically dominated by two parties that differed in how they sought to interact with the People's Republic of China (PRC). This year, we have a third party as well as an individual who has opted to run as an independent. Nevertheless, notes Reuters, The Players The incumbent political party is the Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) , a party that de facto stands for the protection of Taiwan's independent status and views the mainland with skepticism. The public mission of the DPP is "," but the party also refused to accept the "," an agreement made by the KMT with the CCP acknowledging there is only one China. | | ---|---|--- Taiwan's Vice President William Lai, also a presidential front-runner, delivers a speech during a press conference in Taipei, Taiwan, April 12, 2023. Source: Current Taiwan president Tsai Ing-wen leads the DPP party and is wrapping up her second term. Lai Ching-te, Tsai's current vice president, is the party's candidate in the upcoming presidential election. He is a former doctor who in 2017 called himself a "." (In the eyes of Beijing, making such statement is tantamount to treason.) At a recent national DPP convention, Lai stated his commitment to strengthening Taiwan's defense capabilities while also expressing a willingness to engage China, but only "on an equal basis." Lai is currently leading in the polls. The Kuomintang (KMT) , also known as the Nationalist Party of China, is the political group most closely aligned with the Chinese Communist Party and seeks to increase engagement with Beijing. Despite being in power on the mainland during the Republican Era (1928-1949), the party fled to the island of Taiwan on December 7, 1949 when it lost the Chinese civil war. | | ---|---|--- New Taipei City Mayor Hou Yu-ih raises his fist during a speech following his confirmation as the presidential candidate for Taiwan's main opposition Kuomintang, at their headquarters in Taipei. Source: The KMT has been presented the current election as a choice between war and peace...and noted that a vote for the DPP is a vote for war. The KMT candidate for the upcoming election is Hou Yu-ih, a former police chief turned mayor of New Taipei City. Hou seeks to engage the CCP and strengthen ties between Taipei and Beijing in an effort to de-escalate tensions. Critics suggest the KMT has deep ties to the CCP and is therefore beholden to Beijing. In 2019, a third party entered Taiwan's political scene. The Taiwan 's People Party (TPP) was formed with a basic premise: the ROC's relationship with the PRC isn't the only issue affect the citizens of Taiwan. The TPP had a marginal impact during the 2020 elections, but has recently been surging in popularity, particularly among younger voters. TPP's founder, chairman, and current candidate, Ko Wen-je, is a former doctor who served as mayor. He's vowed to unite Taiwan and is currently polling in 2nd place, behind Lai. | | ---|---|--- Source: The fourth contender for the President's office is the billionaire entrepreneur Gou Tai-ming, founder of Foxconn, the manufacturing company that has Apple, Google and Amazon among its top clients. Gou failed to secure the KMT nomination and later opted to run as an independent, launching his campaign in August 2023. Gou needs to secure 290,000 signatures (~1.5% of the number of votes cast in the last presidential election) before November 2 to qualify as a candidate. In early October, . | | ---|---|--- Foxconn founder Gou Tai-ming; Source: Gou's platform is focused on increasing trust across the Taiwan Strait with a focus on peace: "." He plans to do this by increasing engagement with the PRC, doubling the rate of economic growth, and making Taiwan's GDP per capita the highest in Asia. . What to Watch . Although a large percentage of voters remain undecided, . Although he's still the front-runner, . Simple math suggests a coalition between the KMT and TPP could dethrone DPP dominance, leading to a more Beijing-friendly government in Taipei. . Another factor to watch is Beijing. In an The Economist noted how Chinese efforts have ramped up to present the United States (not China) as the island's biggest threat. The article highlights a claim that America wanted to blow up Taiwan's biggest chipmaker. It was promoted via on Douyin, China's version of TikTok. . Another example of Chinese disinformation includes . After the story spread rapidly, it went on to suggest that the government was going to collect 150,000 samples of Taiwanese blood for the Americans to develop a virus to kill ethnic Chinese people. Will these disinformation efforts work? It's unclear. They are all reminiscent of the CCP's efforts going into the 2020 election, when the University of Gothenburg in Sweden found that Taiwan was "." While it's impossible to know how effective those efforts were, the 2019-2020 Hong Kong protests dominated headlines, leading voters concerned about China to vote for the DPP. . Could the CCP try to scare the population into voting for the KMT? So What? If Hou wins , Chinese hopes for a peaceful reintegration of Taiwan rise while military tensions fall. Could it begin a process of a peaceful reunification? Given domestic weakness within the PRC, I imagine the political narratives would drift to the rear as economic topics regained center stage. Derek Grossman, a senior defense analyst at the RAND Corporation who formerly served as an intelligence adviser at the Pentagon, summarized the situation quite succinctly: "" My sense is that a TPP, Gou, or a KMT-TPP coalition victory would also be much preferred to a DPP victory, but less desired than a KMT win. If Lai wins , escalation risks increase dramatically, quite possibly leading to military conflict. Xi Jinping might find the regression away from peaceful reunification unacceptable and, with the Western world distracted by ongoing wars in Ukraine and Israel, conclude it was time to militarily reunify with Taiwan. It's possible that Chinese economic weakness, combined with Taiwanese saber-rattling, would prevent war from breaking out. Time recently reported "." Might the report change Beijing's calculus? possible impact of a Lai victory is termination of the , the free trade agreement between China and Taiwan. Xi Jinping might find the regression away from peaceful reunification unacceptable and, with the Western world distracted by ongoing wars in Ukraine and Israel, conclude it was time to militarily reunify with Taiwan. If the election leads to war , China will be the target of many sanctions, further impacting an already slowing domestic economy. It might even lead Chinese citizens to question the legitimacy of the CCP. Would Beijing be willing to bear this risk? Further, , which could pit two nuclear armed nations against each other. Other US and Taiwanese allies, such as Australia and Japan, might also join the conflict, massively increasing the possibility of the war spreading. And of course, an invasion of Taiwan would lead both local and global economies into a recession as overwhelming uncertainty would reduce consumer and business confidence. The semiconductor industry would be paralyzed, disrupting the entire supply chains of products that contain chips. The US dollar, gold, US treasuries and bitcoin would likely rise in value as global capital would head to safe havens. As we rapidly approach the January election, it's important to remember Regardless of what they choose, economic and political ripples are likely to wash up on distant shores. name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: it all comes down to this week
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

Even as I write you, _Students for Life Action’s_ army of students are busy packing.

Not to go back home and see family. Not to head out with friends for a hike in the mountains or to catch a football game. [](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sjrdhhk-duchtdja-y/)

**They’re packing for what each and every one of them understands could be the most important weekend of 2023.**

With the vote over Ohio’s _Issue 1_ abortion referendum coming down to the wire and Virginia Democrats having effectively chosen abortion as their one-and-only campaign issue in order to keep control of the Virgina Senate & block all pro-life legislation, **the stakes are higher than ever.**

_Every door our students knock on, every interstate overpass we expose pro-abortion radicalism, every text we send, every phone call we make, and every new pro-life voter we convert on campus matters_.

That’s why I’m counting on you for two things today, Pro-Life Friend.

**1)_Will you please keep our army of student activists in your prayers_?**
Please pray for their effectiveness, that God will give them the appropriate words to speak, and that He will keep them safe from pro-abortion radicals.
**2)** **[Will you please agree to your most generous contribution to _Students for Life Action’s_ GOTV Deployment Fund](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sjrdhhk-duchtdja-j/)?**
I know I’ve asked you for so much lately – maybe more than I ever have. Please understand that I don’t feel like I have a choice!
**Pro-Life Friend, the lives of little babies are hanging in the balance.**

You see, with pro-life battles raging across the country, the media elites, pollsters, and political “experts” are all waiting to see if the Abortion Lobby has the momentum heading into 2024.

And what happens in Ohio and Virginia next week will have HUGE ramifications nationwide!

If passed, Ohio’s abortion referendum would:

******* Enshrine abortion-on-demand in Ohio’s state constitution throughout all nine months of pregnancy;
******* Allow abortionists to commit abortions on pregnant minors without parents knowing anything about it; and
******* Allow surgeons to mutilate the bodies of minors with sex change surgeries and allow Planned Parenthood to dispense hormone treatment, that could sterilize them forever, to these same minors with zero parental involvement.
**[_DONATE TO _Students for Life Action’s_ GOTV DEPLOYMENT FUND_](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sjrdhhk-duchtdja-i/)**
And as one of the few states that has off-year elections this year, Virginia will be one of THE biggest tests to see who will have the momentum going into 2024 – either pro-lifers or the Abortion Lobby?

Virginia is a state President Biden won by 10%.

_But in 2021, Republicans took control of the Governor’s Mansion and the House of Delegates_.

Should pro-lifers take the State Senate in 2023, it could pave the way for major pro-life reforms – and send shivers down the spines of pro-abortion politicians nationwide!

**That's why it's critical that our students are on the ground in Ohio and Virginia making sure they reach every pro-life voter with the TRUTH.**

**[So, can I count on you to make your most generous contribution possible to _Students for Life Action’s_ critical GOTV Deployment Fund today](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sjrdhhk-duchtdja-d/)?**

Your support could help us send jaws dropping across the country.

With time running out, we have to put the pedal to the metal.

There’s not a moment to waste!

We’re spending every dollar as soon as it’s given.

_What we accomplish over these next few days will be determined by what we can raise_.

That’s why I hope you will agree to give generously, Pro-Life Friend.
[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sjrdhhk-duchtdja-h/)
Every dollar you can give will be put to immediate use.

_Thousands of pre-born babies are counting on us for their chance at life._

**[_So, please make your most prayerful donation to Students for Life Action's GOTV Deployment Fund right away_](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sjrdhhk-duchtdja-k/).**

Our involvement will have a national impact by building a narrative that life is winning.

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, Students for Life Action

**[_DONATE TO _Students for Life Action’s_ GOTV DEPLOYMENT FUND_](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sjrdhhk-duchtdja-u/)**

Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

subject: Important Food Shortage Notice
body:
This might be your only warning.

**The Truth About The Coming Food Crisis** **This might be your only warning.** According to official reports, dangerous global events have reached America, putting the entire nation in harm's way. Despite this imminent crisis, mainstream media remains silent... And our own government ignores dire warnings of industry experts like fourth-generation American farmers who warn: **_" Food shortages are coming."_** Imagine the panic of seeing empty grocery store shelves, not for a few days, but for several weeks or even months. The loss will be beyond what you can imagine. **As a result of this crisis, survival food is more important than ever.** If you don't take action or if you stockpile the wrong foods, you could be setting your family up to go hungry in a time of crisis. It sounds harsh, but the truth is too many people with good intentions are making critical mistakes with their survival food. Mistakes like...
* Getting MREs with a 5-year shelf life - depending on where you purchase them from they could be near expired...
* Getting gross survival foods that are tough to stomach and so high in salt, MSG and preservatives you could clog your arteries and get yourself sick...
* Or simply getting the wrong foods and leaving a critical hole in your meal plan, which means you risk becoming malnourished...

**Well, no need to worry anymore.** Obviously, waiting for the government to give me a handout in a disaster just wasn't an option for me. And I was completely turned off by the crazy high cost of survival food sold by some companies. That's why I ordered and got my very own stockpile of these best-selling [**Survival Food Kits**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zq10ds718s5t1tfou0m8p6qd9q43ftln4h7vs010_rp22sh2s8i66p70stimeoj6c3h2bs). When you secure your own food stockpile, you will have the peace of mind and security knowing that when a crisis hits... You will be able to calmly reassure your family that they're safe and they will have plenty to eat. [**Click here to secure your own stockpile of these best-selling survival food kits while you still can.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6rjblm7l6646br4744nt9f5g06c5n84316rhdj8_rp22sh2s8i66p70stimeoj6c3h2bs) When a crisis hits, the masses begin to panic, and grocery stores are wiped out. It quickly becomes every man for himself. Don't make the mistake of waiting until it is too late. [**Stock up now**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zsj1pnbiif5vjkm6v66n26e0lsdvcgr1m1ttr5ao_rp22sh2s8i66p70stimeoj6c3h2bs) on these survival food kits while you can.

| More about Russell Prescott: A New Hampshire native of the Seacoast, Russell Prescott grew up in Exeter and currently lives in Kingston. For several decades, he was the co-owner and vice-president of R.E. Prescott Company, a wholesale distributor and manufacturer of water treatment systems. He purchased the business in 2020 and is now the president and sole owner.
Russell practiced Professional Engineering for 30 years and designs many of the products his company manufactures. As a result, he holds several patents for removing arsenic and radon from water. The company, founded in 1954 by his father, employs approximately 50 people and has operated in the same Exeter building since 1963.
Wanting to give back to his community, Prescott served five terms as a New Hampshire State Senator, being first elected in 2000 for two terms. He was re-elected in 2010, 2012, and again in 2014. As Senator, he represented Senate Districts 19 and 23, including towns from Newmarket to Plaistow and Derry to Seabrook.
Prescott was then twice elected to the Executive Council, once in 2016 and again in 2018. He decided to retire from the Executive Council in 2021 after purchasing his company.
Russell enjoys home restoration and recently finished a restoration of a 1737 colonial barn and grist mill in his town. His community service included Exeter Rotary Club, Kingston Lions Club, and the board of directors for the Exeter Area Chamber of Commerce.
He and his wife, Susan, have been married for 41 years, and they have five grown children and seven grandchildren. Following in their grandfather's and father's footsteps, his oldest three children are heavily involved with the daily operation and vision of the family business.

## U.S. Set to Upgrade Nuclear Arsenal
The Pentagon announced plans to build [a more modern nuclear bomb](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1y6yAQQOGnQR2aBfRjFRS3UefbptSsYLHxIGAQMsnbZ5I69WnOfB_37Y4--Pj4jwfp6tKGpvo3bQK4ElyqbeisdkSSVEdaTMttHqd5HLunRrmAdYCEEq0VA5Hab86Y2QLQbkzntQSpBCgByziMqgdYJjEv6rYrARMoNgBZX1PpX8nH-iQXvtKbSm_S0QX9rDWfTP1jcmVyba31Ln1GaudPZ3K9TibXTLHiI0WOMaYrGjp5pMbjZQJh4Xs6di4HXv1BJz9SIZ5To-KuwG1JOZPlL8wYu6Jtbj4Ef04zG-BxoA-_I_Vvl-8AAAD__31UZwA)--24 times as powerful as the ones dropped on Japan--to replace America's aging stockpile. The new gravity bomb, designed to be dropped from an airplane, will be designated as B61-13 and [would replace the old B61-7s,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O6yAQRp8Gd1gDA_4pKG5Dl9tuaUEYO6wwRDYJytuvvPV2X_FJ5-h83Zabiynm7b_bydS1LO5e45sWARwFl7ioLpiVSBJ2ZMQwT6MeRq27h3EaJwhqQvCA6BGV0yIEL2ZyQjvoopEgUQAKmLXS2APMgxhnnDwKGACZAgqxlqP_LjHXB63pU9509Peyd8k8an2eDP8xaZm0rbU-0Er5pEztvD5M2ifl6raSmbQXjEkr4Nojk_Z18lq4f8UUeKbG8-ueyB18O9w71g_3ZfdM2u4w4dliSvEcRqZg211Mvwr17yI_AQAA__9NWV-u) which date to the 1980s and '90s. The maximum yield would be 360 kilotons. The Pentagon said the military needed to modernize to maintain a deterrence force against China and Russia and to give the President more options to strike "harder and large-area military targets."
## Violent Threats Target Jews at Cornell
Cornell University was put on high alert and state police were called in [to protect Jewish students threatened with graphic violence](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L2OwyAQBOCnwR0RsAabguIad7n2SovY65iIHws2ifL2J1993UifNBrNz3W--hBDvn_7hI62MvuFwgtnKThIrmDuu9VtiAqhQyeNHQdtBq273Wm59DettBmltv1qNoTVWwGgb8M4KN8Fp4QCKUAKq3sNFyGskYOF8QZSGAGsF7gGKvXyKCHTjlv8lBfWy1JSF91OdDQGX0xNTE35c5RGJzE1ncVMTVKc2Z6K78bUtJSaMUZeMvcRK3G_EVaesDV_x8Zpr-gJM198Op6NP_Ad2s6XktIzB_owNXXVrcc7xBiaGVgv7smH-LeI_j_oNwAA___oVWWi) on a university message board this weekend. The FBI was alerted as well. One message threatened a [shooting of "Jew pigs,"](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGvnDAQhH-N6UDrXcBQUKRxd2lTIgcvx0YGn_Dm0P37J179mtEUM5rR9-cxP4IkOZ6_w86TrnkOi8qbZws12Rppbqs4rczIVPFk-3FwXe-6rtomHlrAOHYtQE8xOuxodf1q0Y5h4MVVMiEgWSALY9d21ACMvXUjDX_JQg9kWuAoms_mX5ZDN17TJ7_5bJa8V2naVF_F0C-D3qC_rqv5X4LmGD53wKAvms-PQX_wVQz6V06istz2HjboLRj0dEs4VOrCu6iUvdbt5KClvhsL10s-D07JoHeWBhgGC-AM-uqc4uuSlKT0zrTw3IOk73P6M6uvAAAA__8ajWbN) another called for raping Jewish girls, and yet another exhorted students to follow Jewish students home and slit their throats. New York Gov. Kathy Hochul called in the state police, who kept guard over buildings where Jewish students gathered. [The Justice Department and Homeland Security](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LmOpDAUheGngczIG4sDB5OQ1aQTIi-X4o68IHyrUL99qzru-EvO-f89tofDhOX512WwtNfNBcI3bIIzJZhUm-6j3QEkqB6smMwyj9M8jv1hl6h1FFEqs8clOj-FJUZnZq-FUV7IHq3kUgmuBDejHtXAuZnEbNTileATV53mEJHqNfyvWOiAPX3VN1xDqLlP9iA6W6f-dHLt5Hrf91B8KHC3j3dyPWtCwtA-eCABO-qrQSdXjxEKczFjwUaXI6yFfY7V0lio2TtirhA2yEjYMgs1JXgCCy6frwaNXaE4IeUsZH_ZeN6YErZp7jR_ZofpZyD93us7AAD__9ajbr8) are now working with colleges to track antisemitic threats.
## Auto Strike Ends as Union Settles With GM
The United Auto Workers reached a tentative [deal with General Motors](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGStCAQBOCnwQwLGEQJCP7EbP_0Qgt1WLlC2YJxrX37Ky--tDv5ur8e08PHFI_nf7-jo5Anv1B84yQFB8kVTLpZXUBUCA06aezQd6bvumZzGkCCAdSDtXOvbOi9NGHQwaC3c9BNdEookAKksJ3uoBXCGtlbGGaQwghgWuAaKZf2O8eDNgzpk99Y2iXvTXIb0asy-MfUyNR4XVdb8CQs9e6ZGuezxgNrZWr0J-XKqfijvnIhTzEfTI3PnRf0y4aVEx53_Ea-ok_8irTx01-85rMsyKv_VH5z-b1cMDU2xa2vK6YUq-mZFs_dx_Qro7-P-gkAAP__v11p0A) on Monday, ending the six-week-old strike against the three major automakers. The UAW had already struck deals with Ford and Stellantis. The four-year deal with Ford set the template for the settlements. UAW workers [will get a 25% wage increase](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2uqzAQhJ_GdItsr_krKNLQ5ba3RAss4BxsI-PEytsfJfVpZzSjT9__-3gne1i__SPHfVrDSHOyLx6VBFSgcTTF0q_MmrHgXtVd21R1U1XF3psa146ZurlGNAZp1bMhmqhVqqlkW9heS41KopJdZSospexq1XTYTqhkLVEYyYtNIZaPYH3aeT3e4cWxnIMrjn5P6bwE3oQehB5yzqW7_KcTemAPz0vowQXPb6GHObiTvOVPlndKkHaGk_1i_QZPyjDZDRAWpuMCx-RhDRFyiD8cL5jswh7IL98Zz8EH93mlCLebejSmW4vYL2e2x2GvuhFGbo7s8QVNf3v7DQAA___QfW6e) over the contract term, better 401K terms, and concessions on union representation at new plants. The union's novel strategy of selecting a subset of targets for walkouts with minimum notice proved effective at pressuring the automakers while keeping most workers at their jobs, a big savings for the union.

Auto Strike Ends as Union Settles With GM The United Auto Workers reached a tentative on Monday, ending the six-week-old strike against the three major automakers. The UAW had already struck deals with Ford and Stellantis. The four-year deal with Ford set the template for the settlements. UAW workers over the contract term, better 401K terms, and concessions on union representation at new plants. The union's novel strategy of selecting a subset of targets for walkouts with minimum notice proved effective at pressuring the automakers while keeping most workers at their jobs, a big savings for the union. This might be your only warning.

**The Truth About The Coming Food Crisis** **This might be your only warning.** According to official reports, dangerous global events have reached America, putting the entire nation in harm's way. Despite this imminent crisis, mainstream media remains silent... And our own government ignores dire warnings of industry experts like fourth-generation American farmers who warn: **_" Food shortages are coming."_** Imagine the panic of seeing empty grocery store shelves, not for a few days, but for several weeks or even months. The loss will be beyond what you can imagine. **As a result of this crisis, survival food is more important than ever.** If you don't take action or if you stockpile the wrong foods, you could be setting your family up to go hungry in a time of crisis. It sounds harsh, but the truth is too many people with good intentions are making critical mistakes with their survival food. Mistakes like...
* Getting MREs with a 5-year shelf life - depending on where you purchase them from they could be near expired...
* Getting gross survival foods that are tough to stomach and so high in salt, MSG and preservatives you could clog your arteries and get yourself sick...
* Or simply getting the wrong foods and leaving a critical hole in your meal plan, which means you risk becoming malnourished...

**Well, no need to worry anymore.** Obviously, waiting for the government to give me a handout in a disaster just wasn't an option for me. And I was completely turned off by the crazy high cost of survival food sold by some companies. # Final week to see The Art of Democracy
---
There’s still time to see The Art of Democracy exhibition featuring work from 13 artists in Western PA and the Justseeds Artists Cooperative. The show is a collaboration between Keystone Progress Education Fund and Casey Droege Cultural Productions. It explores how democracy impacts censorship, reproductive justice and abortion access, workers' rights, and economic justice, and asks us all to consider what a healthy democracy should look like. This is especially relevant with the upcoming election on November 7th! **Location:** [Repair the World Pittsburgh](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDNHIR3W_Me_BqTqo7RdH4wyJn9cx_p0m8Gc4UNlqpUqNq-py67Oq8_Nx-wr4jzQbYd3GblmtvYcqFm3zD4LEjibVKJrqUS0o9p2PkECT19UF6-iBs6LJEOAMa2HJMCy1bvCcAuHtPTLWbX3fNAYss17tKbHSkGmXocjJQIoRy6_bcCZ-Q0fIeXMtbRO4iTPpHE3aWFJjB2bMaATfaJvO8ODLzl9i1MNfwWUOq_nfyltrYNgzWQYT8I4b18l3re-vujQRkGlBRYS5MSpaFZLgD9d8jSm90h214UVKVwxVLRKlidFbqfxlPashtdYVE5Op-_tDnYr5dh262MGMvg58cAM/40w/S9n9RLLMRImaxhO6xQX22A/h10/exdDg6iH_PqyqD7R0jERTaUzD_WLt6ire3uTkptZPEc) at the East End Cooperative Ministry Building: 6140 Station Street, Pittsburgh, PA 15206

Friend,
I'm proud of the campaign we ran last cycle. Considering redistricting, we moved the needle for Democrats by five points. Now, we need to build on the momentum and introduce myself to more voters.
In the last three weeks of the last campaign, feeling pressure from the polls, Rep. Jack Bergman dumped over $600,000 on a dishonest attack ad that insinuated I wanted to kill babies and euthanize children. It called me the "scariest liberal in Michigan."
It was absurd. It was awful. I served my country honestly and ethically in healthcare for 40 years, but to the uninformed voter, it did its damage. The ad got so much backlash for its lies that it was eventually pulled from the air.
And, , this is the kind of investment in television that we're competing against again this cycle.
Television advertising is crucial to winning an election, but it's expensive. You'll likely see a short ad for my candidacy on TV as soon as Thanksgiving of this year. I just need your help airing it.
Rest assured, we'll hold Bergman accountable on the airwaves. We'll hit the message hard, but it will be honest; brutally honest.
Any amount you can contribute today, whether it's $5, $50, or $500, will go directly to how far we can extend this upcoming ad.
My time to fund it is tight, and we're up against a looming end-of-the-month deadline tonight at midnight. Can you please chip in?
I appreciate your consideration,
-Dr. Bob

## Katy Pride Festival
_(Katy, Texas)_
I had an incredible time at the**first-ever** Katy Pride festival organized by Katy Pride LGBTQ Inc. It's important to celebrate diversity and promote inclusivity. I am proud to have been a part of such an amazing event!

# Early Voting
_(Coldspring, Texas)_
Early voting for this November's election is underway, featuring crucial issues such as increasing retired teacher pay, lowering property taxes, and improving infrastructure like the power grid and rural internet access. Some ballots may also include local government and school board positions, so be sure to participate in shaping your community's future.
---
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=1f841819cc&e=a2a46ff12c)
|
## Fundraising Concert
_(Conroe, Texas)_
Thank you to everyone who attended our campaign fundraising concert event! Your presence and support made it a success. We are grateful for each and every one of you who came out to enjoy the fantastic live music and to those who contributed to our cause. Your generosity will propel our campaign forward and help us grow our grassroots campaign.

[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=bbe3483108&e=a2a46ff12c)
| | | | | | | | |
## Acres Homes
_(Houston, Texas)_
I attended an inspiring fundraiser hosted by The Friends of Beulah Shepard Legacy in the **Acres Homes** **neighborhood of Houston**. It was an honor to learn about Beulah Shepherd, a political icon and community activist who made a lasting impact on this community.
---

| | | | | | | | |
# Candidate Recruitment
_(Conroe, Texas)_
At the Montgomery County Democratic Party headquarters, I attended an event aimed at bolstering Democrats and progressives in red and rural Texas districts. As a former Montgomery County candidate, I joined a panel to discuss our collective vision for a brighter future.
---
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=0500ebce91&e=a2a46ff12c)
|
## Food Pantry
_(Livingston, Texas)_
I had a great time volunteering at the MannaFest food pantry. When we join forces and work hand in hand, we can accomplish so much more for our community.
---
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=fe5556f6ea&e=a2a46ff12c)
| | | | | | | | |
## Cy-Fair Canvassing
## _(Houston, Texas)_

I joined the Cy-Fair Strong Schools team to canvass for the upcoming school board election in the Cy-Fair School District. We're urging our community to vote, regardless of whether they have children in school, as **school board elections historically have low turnout.** Early voting is ongoing until November 3rd, and Election Day is on November 7th. Your vote matters, so please participate if you live in the Cy-Fair area.
---
| [](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=fb616fc90e&e=a2a46ff12c)
---
|
---
**Legislative Update **
In the legislative recap of the October 2023 House of Representatives voting activities, several significant bills and resolutions were considered. On October 2nd, the House voted on **H.R. 4502** , the Modernizing Acquisition & Cyber Security Experts bill, with a strong majority of 394 in favor, only one against, and 34 members marked as present or not voting. On October 3rd, **H. Res 757** , addressing the Speaker Vacancy, saw a close vote with 216 in favor, 210 against, and 7 members marked as present. On October 17th, **Roll 521** featured the Jordan for Speaker vote, resulting in 200 in favor and 232 against. The following day, on October 18th, the same vote took place in **Roll 523** , with 199 in favor and 234 against. On October 20th,**Roll 525** saw 194 in favor and 235 against for the Jordan for Speaker vote. On October 25th, **Roll 527** featured the Johnson for Speaker vote, resulting in 220 in favor, 209 against, and 4 members marked as present. On the same day, **H. Res 771** , which aimed to "Stand With Israel," passed overwhelmingly with 412 in favor, 10 against, and 11 marked as present. Finally, on October 26th, **H.R. 4394** , addressing Energy & Water Development Appropriations, passed with 210 in favor, 199 against, and 24 members marked as present. It is worth noting that **H.R. 4394** included a cut to Climate Action Spending and passed as part of the Inflation Reduction Act. These voting results exclude committee, quorum, and amendment votes.

name: Nikki Haley
subject: Moment to talk?
body:
I’m hoping you’ll consider pitching in a generous gift today!

| |
---
| | | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z7gheoqv9v12fcu5i6c871rmo0ai2dhhsl0jrs6g_rp22sh2s8i66p70sthm1o34cdh2bs)
---

Hi Friend,

Whether you've been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate, I couldn't be more grateful to have a chance to connect with you.

Now, I think it's important to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z705f43bioel9dpf04mgqe04j7mhu0302mls99oo_rp22sh2s8i66p70sthm1o34cdh2bs "Once youâ€TMve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | | | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z2se9i7ccetiu51nrp716cuvkm1fjl2i9hvsucfo_rp22sh2s8i66p70sthm1o34cdh2bs)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---

Hi Friend,

Whether you’ve been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate, I couldn’t be more grateful to have a chance to connect with you.

Now, I think it’s important to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c672648%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=SYeSJTKLS9PzNq%2ft983cFQ&sysid=1 "Once youâ€TMve
finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help
me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | | | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c672647%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=CqMKA7utOIQNeYeYrpL1wQ&sysid=1)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family’s business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _“Don’t complain. Do something about it.” _

---
| | | So, that’s exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn’t easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**
---
| | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c672647%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=CqMKA7utOIQNeYeYrpL1wQ&sysid=1)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn’t know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn’t have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the “kick-me” sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn’t know what hit them.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c672647%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=CqMKA7utOIQNeYeYrpL1wQ&sysid=1)

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for President of the United States.

I’m running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I’m running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I’m running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A.

I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I’m running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor”** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I’ve done it before. **And I’ll do it as your next President. **

As President, I’ll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America’s future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c672758%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Wa1hAeuaSzmSdB6ICkaUGA&sysid=1 "Will you join me today and

Whether you've been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate, I couldn't be more grateful to have a chance to connect with you.

| | | | | [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zvce8lfjmuddrol0r9g5phiotj7veoceo4plsito_rp22sh2s8i66p70sthmep32cjh2bs)

---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

---

Hi Friend,

Whether you've been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate, I couldn't be more grateful to have a chance to connect with you.

Now, I think it's important to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zojc46fhc83k8vbpm7o4iqrdnrshln8k99219c7o_rp22sh2s8i66p70sthm1o34c3h2bs "Once youâ€TMve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | | | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zbk7jjkd85vjh1abahakpajpb68746j4qrm8ogb0_rp22sh2s8i66p70sthm1o34c3h2bs)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**
---
| | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zf92qsau9hgfq7j9lle1lf420qim76uj052v2ut0_rp22sh2s8i66p70sthm1o34c3h2bs)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2za0u8g13cqukommqrjrf7776g96mrurdn5ft8alg_rp22sh2s8i66p70sthm1o34c3h2bs)
---

I launched my campaign for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class.

Now, I just completed my **SECOND** debate, and I need a **SURGE** of support to keep the momentum strong in order to continue sharing this message across America! **[It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!>>](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z6afg67cdk14987ve5vniori1ejte4uo2u5rbsv8_rp22sh2s8i66p70sthm1o34c3h2bs "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate.")**

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will showcase the tremendous momentum we have gained since last quarter!

**I 'm hoping you'll consider pitching in a generous gift today!**

**[Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the power of OUR movement?>>](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zc5jm79or9c4m09ovtic1dbuqvuj4l4pf3cd7cfo_rp22sh2s8i66p70sthm1o34c3h2bs "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate.")**

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

Dear Friend, Populism is nothing new to world history. While it
can be easy to think about American politics as being divided
between the Left and the Right, the reality is much
different.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWkz8K6i5N

Dear
Friend,
Populism
is nothing new to world history. While it can be easy to think
about American politics as being divided between the Left and the
Right, the reality is much different. What we've really been
seeing is two sets of populist backlash against both the Democrat
and Republican establishment.

And
believe it or not, these tensions actually trace their roots back
to Roman times.

That's
why I'm sending you this email today.

I want to
make sure you get a free copy of one of our popular eBooks:
Dueling Populisms by Victor Davis Hanson.

Hanson is
a Hoover Senior Fellow and world-renowned historian, and I think
you'll get a lot out of his insights. Inside this important
eBook, you'll learn more about:

What
we can expect from a political climate ruled by movements that
rebel against both the establishment-and each other.
The
important parallels between these ancient movements and their
modern counterparts in both progressive and conservative
populism.
What
lies ahead for America as we revive these ancient tensions in our
culture.

You can
get your free copy of Dueling Populisms using this secure link:
https://resources.hoover.org/dueling-populisms-signup/.

And
please feel free to share this with your family and friends. It's
important that we recall the voices of experience and apply them
to contemporary conflicts and challenges.

You can
use this link to get access to your free eBook right now.

Thanks,
Greg

| | **_BREAKING NEWS_ : Activists launch global HUNGER STRIKE to hold Formosa Plastics accountable for their environmental disasters! [_Sign the petition to support their demands!_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2086680?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** Formosa Plastics is responsible for devastation across the world, Friend. In Texas, they **illegally released billions of plastic pellets into waterways** for years. In Louisiana, they’re trying to build a giant plastics complex in an area already so polluted that it’s nicknamed **Cancer Alley.** And in 2016, a Formosa plant’s toxic release **ruined the livelihoods of MILLIONS of people** in Vietnam. Now, many brave souls are launching a Hunger Strike to DEMAND justice for those hurt by Formosa’s legacy of harm. They’ll need as much help as they can get, Friend – _**and every day activists will be getting hungrier**_ , which is why we need you to act right now!
