| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE TUESDAY, OCTOBER 31
GREATER GEORGIA CALLS ON SECRETARY OF STATE TO GET BACK TO WORK
ATLANTA - Today, following the release of a [new report](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0014Q7uNxwNBFgUB6v0cUG4mQoyZ5DxuvhhZYS--aA067AKlLFNkmjXjOjyv9j59d5VYrZtKATpHte0T5FmqWwv5dZ9A0RzDkWAXRnlwV2vy5qDl_52P9XorbmLa-WOcbUkYzQfU9SOqR3FAM7m8wXerkADYTnms8YUGAtw-ti4i3811URVtmsgR5a8DL_cFYNQyvUcVgzkwHgL9V8HbTL57eSusqYnmculpDThG_M9-6yJlN6WyTJfemywdZw30teG&c=qvGkY5ciBlNiXnoFaTTAkRi0NDdITmeJlR_w4CY7QR_Rb6GG2r_Ipw==&ch=fJDJKVUYoV2lx_-cewDMzctmDL9vgxqF8IblQdFt1qmCX0kFPh7kvw==) by the Washington Examiner, Greater Georgia Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler called on Georgia's top election official to return to his taxpayer-funded job and direct his full attention to ensuring election integrity - starting by fixing known security vulnerabilities in Georgia's voting machines.
Earlier this year, Greater Georgia and other groups [called](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0014Q7uNxwNBFgUB6v0cUG4mQoyZ5DxuvhhZYS--aA067AKlLFNkmjXjBLrLGqlPMSscGtdfZ2SIkuTmp0FNiQGt79eJ-B1QBlrhuJ_cgg_gfDtA7NKLCAhQ4ZDxaOpLH2bpoGcqD4vJZlQQ5aSAu-Cax-B4wTLs9k6AxUF9JBWm5Jzay-PiM-LKF-msgg-S9XGRSK2foVg3wrLecm-v_Cj6y5B_M5dhxTGtm2LlQxCzYe6i2d9LZlS1rLl9vuBurbYEz3uBTTKfLbjvpBba5jcjQ==&c=qvGkY5ciBlNiXnoFaTTAkRi0NDdITmeJlR_w4CY7QR_Rb6GG2r_Ipw==&ch=fJDJKVUYoV2lx_-cewDMzctmDL9vgxqF8IblQdFt1qmCX0kFPh7kvw==) on Secretary of State Brad Raffensperger to fix a critical [security vulnerability](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0014Q7uNxwNBFgUB6v0cUG4mQoyZ5DxuvhhZYS--aA067AKlLFNkmjXjOjyv9j59d5VId9xnoCDa-QVI8h5Szvv11cLmtMP3puFa6xJR-Flx2z90w1r9B92TV7F4YL8FtShXtikePRw4e6GHSaMm1sqUO7rVvw5dv7OaA6B0QtrPTPBkW2iW9x2GpD6LM6FGyk8hAbvbTnZv5ULLJ3Uu4blVAeBF-pmbC0aL1v9TsOjPbq54f_iA8CWyg==&c=qvGkY5ciBlNiXnoFaTTAkRi0NDdITmeJlR_w4CY7QR_Rb6GG2r_Ipw==&ch=fJDJKVUYoV2lx_-cewDMzctmDL9vgxqF8IblQdFt1qmCX0kFPh7kvw==) in Georgia's voting machines before the 2024 election. Secretary Raffensperger, whose office had been [aware](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0014Q7uNxwNBFgUB6v0cUG4mQoyZ5DxuvhhZYS--aA067AKlLFNkmjXjEYfx1qUpf2gRKtWh4pzD5jtoXphT_uvg7eX1nJkAPDDiY1iEbyfXib6ewObpu-Q367vx0ElzQ028WXIQSglohIZCaSwwIArC4IprwHUtqLNMEMzOi9ZqdOq8s6JZiEPKUYn7oxUeeHNmpHyj1ICw8cwzfYOp0l5jg6KlRqrATYFXx870UHMFBoowmPKOTe6PQr7F4M2Z6Bb&c=qvGkY5ciBlNiXnoFaTTAkRi0NDdITmeJlR_w4CY7QR_Rb6GG2r_Ipw==&ch=fJDJKVUYoV2lx_-cewDMzctmDL9vgxqF8IblQdFt1qmCX0kFPh7kvw==) of the vulnerabilities since 2021, announced that he would not update the machines until at least 2025, [citing](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0014Q7uNxwNBFgUB6v0cUG4mQoyZ5DxuvhhZYS--aA067AKlLFNkmjXjOjyv9j59d5Vs9RPuZj8medW35VushmkhZ9febug5v3WgQgwSM1ngZv8eGUHNp5k5c1JZe2B1nABt_LtSp88goD7pHBU_ArSiFjO9ETgt6cQMX17erIaJNz4LagVGmLCi-05ZNVW2dMNCVnQk98DrzmOD2qw--3g4_s-U7jE7XWcOzeP8bBBkC79RVtuWxku9mz2YRDXRjwu3slQ6MzeCL8=&c=qvGkY5ciBlNiXnoFaTTAkRi0NDdITmeJlR_w4CY7QR_Rb6GG2r_Ipw==&ch=fJDJKVUYoV2lx_-cewDMzctmDL9vgxqF8IblQdFt1qmCX0kFPh7kvw==) a lack of time - despite his advanced notice and the fact that several other states had already taken steps to implement the patch.
But according to open records obtained by Greater Georgia and [verified](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0014Q7uNxwNBFgUB6v0cUG4mQoyZ5DxuvhhZYS--aA067AKlLFNkmjXjOjyv9j59d5VYrZtKATpHte0T5FmqWwv5dZ9A0RzDkWAXRnlwV2vy5qDl_52P9XorbmLa-WOcbUkYzQfU9SOqR3FAM7m8wXerkADYTnms8YUGAtw-ti4i3811URVtmsgR5a8DL_cFYNQyvUcVgzkwHgL9V8HbTL57eSusqYnmculpDThG_M9-6yJlN6WyTJfemywdZw30teG&c=qvGkY5ciBlNiXnoFaTTAkRi0NDdITmeJlR_w4CY7QR_Rb6GG2r_Ipw==&ch=fJDJKVUYoV2lx_-cewDMzctmDL9vgxqF8IblQdFt1qmCX0kFPh7kvw==) by the Washington Examiner, Raffensperger may have been able to execute the update had it been prioritized over cross-country trips to appear with celebrities, Democrat elites, and liberal media. Georgia's top elections official has been to his office 42 days in the first nine months of 2023, averaging five days per month and four hours per visit. Raffensperger, who collects a taxpayer-funded salary of nearly $130,000 plus benefits, has spent about 70% of all work days out of office since 2021.
Over the last few months, Raffensperger has instead attended the [White House Correspondents' Dinner](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0014Q7uNxwNBFgUB6v0cUG4mQoyZ5DxuvhhZYS--aA067AKlLFNkmjXjOjyv9j59d5VZmoNpoAbFifueW1zvZ1xQ_rcwaT8cAhnFpcCToYDEa_zX0YFgLNQAqcFdjzh9XdwCoQJkfKNFEc-98e8jVtc6DmBrJc5ykmzjVl13QN71DaeJF3L-gbl-chBb0AXvTD5lwoDX0dckvfMFQIyUdcunQ==&c=qvGkY5ciBlNiXnoFaTTAkRi0NDdITmeJlR_w4CY7QR_Rb6GG2r_Ipw==&ch=fJDJKVUYoV2lx_-cewDMzctmDL9vgxqF8IblQdFt1qmCX0kFPh7kvw==) in D.C., the [South by Southwest](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0014Q7uNxwNBFgUB6v0cUG4mQoyZ5DxuvhhZYS--aA067AKlLFNkmjXjOjyv9j59d5VRrIHfzoQ-9-eWVaIU-BsTnrxXVK_C3HpMju28e5SeKpjFxEErZhRHaJmUX-1Kd7Qe642DFwKc-veTh0Qt-55iCRAN3vNt21tDtnWYuZOWARNLykdKGXN0g==&c=qvGkY5ciBlNiXnoFaTTAkRi0NDdITmeJlR_w4CY7QR_Rb6GG2r_Ipw==&ch=fJDJKVUYoV2lx_-cewDMzctmDL9vgxqF8IblQdFt1qmCX0kFPh7kvw==) Conference in Austin, and the 2024 [Campaign Journalism Conference](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0014Q7uNxwNBFgUB6v0cUG4mQoyZ5DxuvhhZYS--aA067AKlLFNkmjXjOjyv9j59d5VOc0ZZz1d6Nd0cIgpCJwQuGT28OKIH5lou9tn4TQBZspnAg_wZlz9AG8dkR01X5FM1VEcqBIHNhMwW280st-ZLpg-Lu2RHPMo&c=qvGkY5ciBlNiXnoFaTTAkRi0NDdITmeJlR_w4CY7QR_Rb6GG2r_Ipw==&ch=fJDJKVUYoV2lx_-cewDMzctmDL9vgxqF8IblQdFt1qmCX0kFPh7kvw==) in Chicago - managing to score interviews with [MSNBC](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0014Q7uNxwNBFgUB6v0cUG4mQoyZ5DxuvhhZYS--aA067AKlLFNkmjXjOjyv9j59d5V6oMPqNubt3CkK236Tjtf60DbL9l994Aw7b-a3Hkj2f-frLjSkaFhfxy2-CcGQe1gAEuXPkf3k_pPmqsB3Pz8ofUoEuoTCJORBjFXLt-CFR9sE9VH_-2AyziPj0XEXedokm22FxBRwG82lmmUDDTw_EofdsJz4_XIWvVVuxyPOX96nEp7P7aSdHPkoU7b2Q7qOi4Wrpx0_rLJewCFwJ51n-pyxXO8m8IPA19zOhXtUWs=&c=qvGkY5ciBlNiXnoFaTTAkRi0NDdITmeJlR_w4CY7QR_Rb6GG2r_Ipw==&ch=fJDJKVUYoV2lx_-cewDMzctmDL9vgxqF8IblQdFt1qmCX0kFPh7kvw==) and others. He was recently announced as a headliner for an L.A. conference alongside [Hollywood celebs](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0014Q7uNxwNBFgUB6v0cUG4mQoyZ5DxuvhhZYS--aA067AKlLFNkmjXjOjyv9j59d5VUZozGt5YeKd8VzvYJFgWjglwuNBI5l0KvYqbn54Z56C3WVqyEOWhxNat_0iMonyvvjv6NVmklU3flr2xg5KaOJgdrnaGoe5HoLx7ly203JTctTctHrVHbeHSWcYONQRweE_Fesq-cIm3V7KEwQpl-kEiBbw3anYN7GmpCu8cH-xt-cE0z3qLG1WaKezUgFTQIfNzzpsYHc7g9KvlxbIjRnzD5q0TMzpLVdR7wd13Aj7Iki_bX33WqqWa24KqV3xoiZpURbOnMWx6Czo5YkhikvAhEnacPZ_PrSZW6EgQnlaEgfzix4ooSv3Bzn8mWT9L0nxUNQ5B6GiTyZsHNQpwc1Tn_5_BBs-S&c=qvGkY5ciBlNiXnoFaTTAkRi0NDdITmeJlR_w4CY7QR_Rb6GG2r_Ipw==&ch=fJDJKVUYoV2lx_-cewDMzctmDL9vgxqF8IblQdFt1qmCX0kFPh7kvw==)[ ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0014Q7uNxwNBFgUB6v0cUG4mQoyZ5DxuvhhZYS--aA067AKlLFNkmjXjOjyv9j59d5VUZozGt5YeKd8VzvYJFgWjglwuNBI5l0KvYqbn54Z56C3WVqyEOWhxNat_0iMonyvvjv6NVmklU3flr2xg5KaOJgdrnaGoe5HoLx7ly203JTctTctHrVHbeHSWcYONQRweE_Fesq-cIm3V7KEwQpl-kEiBbw3anYN7GmpCu8cH-xt-cE0z3qLG1WaKezUgFTQIfNzzpsYHc7g9KvlxbIjRnzD5q0TMzpLVdR7wd13Aj7Iki_bX33WqqWa24KqV3xoiZpURbOnMWx6Czo5YkhikvAhEnacPZ_PrSZW6EgQnlaEgfzix4ooSv3Bzn8mWT9L0nxUNQ5B6GiTyZsHNQpwc1Tn_5_BBs-S&c=qvGkY5ciBlNiXnoFaTTAkRi0NDdITmeJlR_w4CY7QR_Rb6GG2r_Ipw==&ch=fJDJKVUYoV2lx_-cewDMzctmDL9vgxqF8IblQdFt1qmCX0kFPh7kvw==)Ed Helms and Michael Douglas.
"Voters are entrusting our elections to a Secretary of State who has spent more time glad-handing liberal elites and attacking conservatives as 'election deniers' than addressing legitimate security issues," said Greater Georgia Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler. "This is not a partisan issue - it's about accountability in a battleground state that will decide the next U.S. President. Ensuring secure elections is not a job that can be done from the green room of MSNBC; right now, with critical security vulnerabilities exposed to the world, this state needs our top elections official to get back to work for the voters of Georgia."
In 2021, Georgia's Secretary of State became the [first official](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0014Q7uNxwNBFgUB6v0cUG4mQoyZ5DxuvhhZYS--aA067AKlLFNkmjXjEYfx1qUpf2gRKtWh4pzD5jtoXphT_uvg7eX1nJkAPDDiY1iEbyfXib6ewObpu-Q367vx0ElzQ028WXIQSglohIZCaSwwIArC4IprwHUtqLNMEMzOi9ZqdOq8s6JZiEPKUYn7oxUeeHNmpHyj1ICw8cwzfYOp0l5jg6KlRqrATYFXx870UHMFBoowmPKOTe6PQr7F4M2Z6Bb&c=qvGkY5ciBlNiXnoFaTTAkRi0NDdITmeJlR_w4CY7QR_Rb6GG2r_Ipw==&ch=fJDJKVUYoV2lx_-cewDMzctmDL9vgxqF8IblQdFt1qmCX0kFPh7kvw==) in the nation to learn about vulnerabilities in the Dominion software - when the University of Michigan audited the state's voting machines as part of a lawsuit. The Department of Homeland Security then issued a [security advisory](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0014Q7uNxwNBFgUB6v0cUG4mQoyZ5DxuvhhZYS--aA067AKlLFNkmjXjEYfx1qUpf2gmPjaBD_6U9NoOtXRsJnGV2n7gRqf8v08rk-0YweXBsYqf6WJvZAwB3t_H1mEr8kXGzG7Xnfq4C0nA1321Y4LRmrKxZilxmSIapuemhV7Y_0K8jgUTI3iACyC93srXRXbGI0Qyj1rHPI=&c=qvGkY5ciBlNiXnoFaTTAkRi0NDdITmeJlR_w4CY7QR_Rb6GG2r_Ipw==&ch=fJDJKVUYoV2lx_-cewDMzctmDL9vgxqF8IblQdFt1qmCX0kFPh7kvw==) in June 2022, urging every state to fix the vulnerabilities "as soon as possible." Dominion subsequently distributed a software update, which was [approved](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0014Q7uNxwNBFgUB6v0cUG4mQoyZ5DxuvhhZYS--aA067AKlLFNkmjXjOjyv9j59d5Vmff06q1kAzj9Zi17Nop2KBFwNbDkA271OA0VfanlSf_53z6Q3K1tohSP5a6q9m8rE4NLO_YE_ugXGHBR7wtjkWB0oS65fzyxreZDjPPVDNIhG7jUUsQYeyt_2gEJsl2C&c=qvGkY5ciBlNiXnoFaTTAkRi0NDdITmeJlR_w4CY7QR_Rb6GG2r_Ipw==&ch=fJDJKVUYoV2lx_-cewDMzctmDL9vgxqF8IblQdFt1qmCX0kFPh7kvw==) for nationwide implementation in March 2023. body:
I had to make a pretty difficult decision yesterday, and I thought you should know about it.
#

Hey there, Peter, it's Ruben again.
I had to make a pretty difficult decision this weekend, and I thought you should know about it.
First, today is our end-of-month deadline. A big day for any campaign. Plus, Kari Lake launched her campaign earlier this month — right after we missed our goal in September. And if that wasn’t bad enough, we’re hearing lots of talk about Kyrsten Sinema these days. She’s getting ready, and with a warchest of close to $11 million she can do a lot to hurt us.
All that is to say one thing — we can’t get ambushed here. Anything can happen right now.
Without saying too much, there are a number of investments we have to make in order to be prepared. Because if our opponents get the jump on us, we’re cooked. Game over.
Since our fundraising slowed down a ton this summer (and since we missed several of our goals), we had to push off making those investments. Until now — until this weekend.
We had to decide this Saturday, and I gave the green light. Even though our budget isn’t quite where we want it to be.
Now, I’m banking on the fact that telling you this will convince you to help us fill the gap.
What that really means is... I need your help. Really. So please:
[**Can you make a $3 contribution to my campaign for Senate today? Every donation will help close our budget gap ahead of tonight’s end-of-month deadline.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct23.kRA6ky&refcode=em231031-1&t=1&akid=1388%2E734936%2Eb7l4Yf)
This was a difficult decision. But if there’s one thing that sets our campaign apart from all the others in this race, it’s you. You are keeping us in this fight.
Thanks for chipping in today if you can afford it.
And thanks for being in this fight,
Ruben

Peter,

When people ask Kelly and me why we keep going, and why we are still compelled to serve in public office, no matter how difficult the days, our answer is simple: _“This is for our children. For ALL of our children and grandchildren.”_

There is a very real question right now whether they will be able to enjoy the same liberty, security, and opportunity that we have. **Freedom is imperiled today and there is a crisis at every turn.**

Kelly and I have four amazing kids, and we give our all--_every day_ --to try to ensure that we can pass along the blessings of liberty to Hannah, Abby, Jack, and Will, and everyone in the generation of Americans that follow us. I am certain that you share that same conviction.

**_I believe that God is not done with America yet._**

**I believe we need to unite as a party and unite as a nation. The hour is late, and the crisis is great – but I am bullish about the future of America.**

I believe in the law – I’m a constitutional law attorney and I respect the law.

**I believe America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of the world – _but our days as the beacon of freedom for the world are numbered if we let the far-left force their anti-American agenda on the rest of us._**

[**Last November, the American people put their faith in House Republicans and gave us a majority. | | _**_Meet Tom Cotton_**_

Tom Cotton was born and raised on his family's cattle farm in Arkansas, served as an Army infantry officer in Iraq and Afghanistan, and is fighting for working Americans in the U.S. Senate.

The tragic attacks of September 11, 2001 occurred during Tom's final year of law school and changed his life's trajectory.

Kat Cammack is serving her second term representing the people of Northeastern Florida in Congress. She won the seat on a conservative platform of growing jobs, securing our southern border, standing up for law enforcement, defending our Second Amendment, promoting fiscal responsibility, and defending life.
Congresswoman Cammack sits on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce and House Committee on Agriculture, where she is the only Florida Republican serving the Sunshine State's farmers, ranchers, and producers. Kat and her husband Matt, who is a firefighter, paramedic, and SWAT medic, proudly call Gainesville, Florida home.

body:
I believe to my core that the most important things in life are God, family, and pride in our country. These are the values that guide me and shape my life.

|
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zflkt3aijq6nrnfd7jndf14illaj294af6cuhhu8_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t6ekr3asjl6ejn9ctiekoj79hnmmrqbd5mmkpbfc5jmprr7dt26irrb83k6mh7fpjm6nh60oj6chg64or7qm99f44jipbp75ul2kbt0l0nq8a9f5uiak9lfkahae9iasblmv8ncdf1a59pb8j0c9j68o36chhiasblmvb7fdbieoqjbojl6dpiasblmvarac9kmlqrbp9lmgqb3cp5e5qrflhk6mo78d5n6equ4d5nm79r3kthqep238h1e8he4933cjgeepr0cth62oh5u)
---
Fellow American,

The most important things in life are faith, family, and freedom. That's not just a slogan, these happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I am fighting every day to preserve them.

**Faith.** Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people.

**Family.** Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way.

**Freedom.** It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I’ve devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress.

body:
I’m hoping you’ll consider pitching in a generous gift today!

| |
---
| | | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35851%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=t5cclLKwbmNdRdQXjGt8qQ&sysid=1)
---

Hi Friend,

Whether you’ve been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate, I couldn’t be more grateful to have a chance to connect with you.

Now, I think it’s important to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35852%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=j0qpi5%2f82gnt3bt%2beK9TIw&sysid=1 "Once youâ€TMve
finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help
me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | | | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35851%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=t5cclLKwbmNdRdQXjGt8qQ&sysid=1)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family’s business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _“Don’t complain. Do something about it.” _

---
| | | So, that’s exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn’t easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**
---
| | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35851%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=t5cclLKwbmNdRdQXjGt8qQ&sysid=1)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn’t know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn’t have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the “kick-me” sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn’t know what hit them.

---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35851%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=t5cclLKwbmNdRdQXjGt8qQ&sysid=1)
---

I launched my campaign for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class.

Now, I just completed my **SECOND** debate, and I need a **SURGE** of support to keep the momentum strong in order to continue sharing this message across America! **[It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!>>](https://secure.winred.com/team-stand-for-america/support-nikki-now-underdog-tv?sc=PRentalTV&recurring=true&utm_campaign=20231027_WG-YAN2.103100_nikki-haley_t1405855-2667&utm_medium=emailp&utm_source=WG-YAN2.103100&utm_content=20231027_moment-to-talk&ex_tid=20231027_WG-YAN2.103100_nikki-haley_t1405855-2667&utm_content=tv-yan-20231031&xunv=tv-yan-20231031 "It would mean a lot to me
if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the
strength of my campaign post-debate. ")**

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will showcase the tremendous momentum we have gained since last quarter!

**I’m hoping you’ll consider pitching in a generous gift today!**

**[Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the power of OUR movement?>>](https://secure.winred.com/team-stand-for-america/support-nikki-now-underdog-tv?sc=PRentalTV&recurring=true&utm_campaign=20231027_WG-YAN2.103100_nikki-haley_t1405855-2667&utm_medium=emailp&utm_source=WG-YAN2.103100&utm_content=20231027_moment-to-talk&ex_tid=20231027_WG-YAN2.103100_nikki-haley_t1405855-2667&utm_content=tv-yan-20231031&xunv=tv-yan-20231031 "It would mean a lot to me

---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35861%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=R8uIUtoWxX%2b%2fQze9Xzx2eQ&sysid=1 "NikkiHaley_Podium")
---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for President of the United States.

I’m running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I’m running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I’m running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A.

I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I’m running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor”** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I’ve done it before. **And I’ll do it as your next President. **

As President, I’ll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America’s future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35862%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=LYRNn5anro7Mzjq1Zc%2fKpA&sysid=1 "Will you join me today and

Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it. After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family’s business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: “Don’t complain. Do something about it.” | | | So, that’s exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn’t easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. | | It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor. When I campaigned for governor, people didn’t know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy. When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn’t have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the “kick-me” sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn’t know what hit them. | I launched my campaign for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class. Now, I just completed my SECOND debate, and I need a SURGE of support to keep the momentum strong in order to continue sharing this message across America! "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate. " Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will showcase the tremendous momentum we have gained since last quarter! I’m hoping you’ll consider pitching in a generous gift today! "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate. " ** | | | | | | | | | | Friend, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. I’m hoping to do the same as your next President. But in order to get there, " I need your help â€“ starting right now. " Your support is what keeps our movement thriving, so thank you for standing with me. My very best, | Nikki Haley | | | | | | "NikkiHaleyMerch" | | "Claim Your Mug" | | More About Nikki Haley | "NikkiHaleyPodium" My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for President of the United States. I’m running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again. I’m running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country. I’m running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A. I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I’m running for President because we have a country to save! I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor” because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery. At the UN I fought for America, made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names. I know how to make America strong and proud because I’ve done it before. And I’ll do it as your next President. body:
A note from DNC's Political Director Brencia Berry | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/42b16fb61522/7-days?e=d6c5c7d7ec)
---
| |
---
| | Hello everyone,
It’s election season! As many of you may have seen, I am stepping into a new [role](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=a5a4595749&e=d6c5c7d7ec) here at the DNC as the Political Director. I am ready to work hand in hand with you as we aim to elect Democrats up and down the ballot. With that in mind, we are in full swing mobilizing voters in key states ahead of the 2023 elections in Virginia, Kentucky, Mississippi, Louisiana, and Pennsylvania. With every seat in the Virginia Senate and House of Delegates up for grabs in this cycle, the stakes of these races couldn't be higher with Governor Youngkin ready and waiting to sign extreme legislation into law should Republicans gain control of both chambers. You can find a phone banking opportunity near you [HERE](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=4dae7a759d&e=d6c5c7d7ec) and canvassing opportunities in Virginia [HERE](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=82389df620&e=d6c5c7d7ec). We really need your help, below you’ll find ways to get involved in the upcoming election and be a vital part of the movement to get out the vote in 2023. Your voice carries immense power, and together we can ensure every eligible voter's voice is heard. Below, you will find ways you can do your part in securing wins for Democrats in Virginia. Please take a moment and sign up for a volunteer shift below and review some additional updates from our Political and Coalitions teams.
Sincerely,
Brencia Berry
---
|

| | **ICYMI: VICE PRESIDENT KAMALA HARRIS INTERVIEW ON 60 MINUTES** Last night, Vice President Kamala Harris spoke with CBS’s 60 Minutes. NBC Contributor Anthony [Coley](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=e12916d29d&e=d6c5c7d7ec) tweeted "VP Harris is on her A game in this 60 Minutes interview—sharp, crisp, charming. Easily the best TV interview of her tenure." The Vice President covered a range of topics, showing strong and thoughtful leadership, sweeping knowledge of multiple policy areas, and clear focus on what is at stake in the 2024 election and how we're going to win:
* "Fight for Our Freedoms" College Tour
* Gun violence, voting rights, reproductive freedom, climate change
* Foreign policy and conflict abroad
* Ways this admin has delivered on healthcare, support for small businesses and creating jobs
* This election - talking about what is at stake and how we're going to win

Find highlights of the interview below: VP Leading on Key Issues Issues: [https://x.com/60Minutes/status/1718777944112587079?s=20](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=f53374358e&e=d6c5c7d7ec)

VP's confidence that "we're going to win" in 2024: [https://x.com/tify330/status/1718781072287174906?s=20](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=22435fb97e&e=d6c5c7d7ec)
David Rothkopf tweet on VP's work: [https://x.com/djrothkopf/status/1718784797898613033?s=20](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=8bd2647678&e=d6c5c7d7ec)

Through direct, one-on-one conversations with voters, we can address questions, provide clarity on candidates' platforms, and encourage voter turnout. **[You can find a phone banking opportunity near you HERE](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=0c67c1a2fa&e=d6c5c7d7ec) ** **Canvassing** The Democratic Party of Virginia is knocking on doors to help get out the vote and inform residents of the importance of the upcoming election. Canvassing is a great opportunity for those looking to get involved in person. **[You can find a canvassing opportunity near you HERE](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=acf48496bc&e=d6c5c7d7ec)**

We can't thank you enough for committing to join the team and impact this critical election.

| **UAW DEAL / DNC AT THE PICKET LINE**
---
|
---
_DNC Chair Jaime Harrison with UAW Local 2250 President Katie Deatherage and DNC members in Wentzville, MO._
| Across the country members of the United Auto Workers have been making sacrifices and walking picket lines in the fight for fair agreements. Six weeks ago the UAW launched a historic Stand Up Strike which has now led to tentative agreements covering 150,000 workers at America’s Big Three automakers. The deals include the biggest gains workers have seen in decades: salary increases, cost of living adjustments, and the elimination of tiered positions. The solidarity and dedication to securing a fair share for America’s autoworkers is a testament to the power of unions and collective bargaining. Read President Biden’s statement on the UAW’s tentative agreement with [Ford](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=8a2db2c814&e=d6c5c7d7ec), [Stellantis](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=597105c3c7&e=d6c5c7d7ec), and [GM. ](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=0ab1970b9f&e=d6c5c7d7ec) During the DNC Fall Meeting in St. Louis, Missouri, Chairman Jaime Harrison, along with more than 100 DNC members, joined the workers of UAW Local 2250 on the picket line.
_Chairman Harrison Interview:_ [DNC highlights support of labor unions, working-class voters](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=3e178ab086&e=d6c5c7d7ec)

| **LGBTQ+ LEADERS ENDORSE JOE BIDEN AND KAMALA HARRIS** _The following is a statement from Biden-Harris Campaign Manager Julie Chavez Rodriguez on today’s announcement of the historic joint endorsement by Human Rights Campaign PAC (HRC PAC), Equality PAC, and the National Center for Transgender Equality Action Fund (NCTE AF):_ "Next year’s election will determine whether LGBTQ+ Americans have more freedoms or less. Across the country, MAGA Republicans are hell-bent on taking away LGBTQ+ Americans' hard-fought freedoms and are using our fellow Americans’ identities for political warfare. It’s shameful and not who we are as a country. The stakes of this election could not be higher for LGBTQ+ Americans, and President Biden and Vice President Harris are committed to fighting for every American’s fundamental freedoms. We are deeply honored to earn this historic, unified endorsement from the nation’s leading LGBTQ+ groups. With their support, we will activate the more than 60 million equality voters nationwide to reelect President Biden and Vice President Harris, and equality legislators up and down the ballot." On October 10, Equality PAC, Human Rights Campaign PAC (HRC PAC), and the National Center for Transgender Equality Action Fund (NCTE AF) endorsed Biden-Harris 2024 – the first time the groups have jointly endorsed a presidential ticket. This endorsement comes ahead of National Coming Out Day and amidst an unprecedented spike in anti-LGBTQ+ state legislation, with more than 550 bills introduced in 43 states, and more than 80 signed into law — more than doubling last year, which was previously the worst year on record. In their endorsement, leaders of these groups highlighted President Biden and Vice President Harris’ actions to strengthen protections for LGTBQ+ Americans, and their steadfast commitment to passing additional federal legislation to strengthen LGBTQ+ rights.

* **[From DNC Chair Jaime Harrison:](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=67ce84e6ec&e=d6c5c7d7ec)** _Love this! @JoeBiden and @KamalaHarris represent unity, equality, and hope – and they will never stop fighting until all LGBTQ+ folks are welcomed, loved, and celebrated. Excited to work alongside @HRC and @HRC_President to finish the job!_
* **[From the Human Rights Campaign](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=839102d85d&e=d6c5c7d7ec) :** _We’ve seen how much of a difference four years can make in the fight for full equality — that’s why we’re endorsing President Biden and Vice President Harris for re-election. Let’s continue to move forward with the Biden-Harris administration. #EqualityIsWorthVotingFor _
* **[From Equality PAC](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=fb43c2bca9&e=d6c5c7d7ec) :** _BREAKING: Equality PAC is proud to join @HRC in endorsing the Biden-Harris ticket in 2024. #LGBTQ rights are on the ballot and @JoeBiden and @KamalaHarris are the only_ _candidates we can put our faith and trust in next year. #EqualityIsWorthVotingFor_
* **[From HRC President Kelley Robinson](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=201685cffd&e=d6c5c7d7ec) :** _Today, we proudly endorse Biden-Harris for 2024! President Biden & Vice President Harris have been champions for LGBTQ+ rights, securing historic victories. Let's protect our freedoms & support pro-equality candidates. Together, we can ensure a future free from discrimination!_
* **[From NCTE Action Fund Executive Director Rodrigo Heng-Lehtinen](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=5bf618c292&e=d6c5c7d7ec) :** _Biden's reelection is critical because his administration has been strongly supporting transgender Americans. The 2024 election stakes are incredibly high. @NCTEActionFund will be making sure trans people get out the vote!_

| **DNC STATEMENT ON HISPANIC HERITAGE MONTH** _DNC Chair Jaime Harrison and DNC Hispanic Caucus Chair Iris Martinez released the following statement marking Hispanic Heritage Month:_ “This Hispanic Heritage Month, we celebrate the diversity of the Hispanic and Latino communities and honor the countless contributions that they have made throughout the history of our nation. As a country built by immigrants, we cherish the activism and sacrifices that Latinos have made to ensure that our country lives up to its ideals of freedom, liberty, and equality for all. From fighting for a more just immigration system to marching for workers’ rights, Latinos have made this country a better nation for all Americans."

| **DNC STATEMENT ON INDIGENOUS PEOPLES’ DAY**
---
|
---
| On Indigenous Peoples’ Day, the DNC released a [joint statement](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=9261fb7a91&e=d6c5c7d7ec) to “honor Indigenous Peoples of the 574 federally recognized tribes as well as Native Hawaiians and Native Pacific Islanders for their countless contributions to our society.” During the DNC’s annual Indigenous Peoples Day Celebration, the DNC Native Caucus’ Chair Clara Pratte and Secretary/Treasurer Ruth Anna Buffalo introduced three surprise guests who talked about the importance of engaging Native communities:

* New Mexico Governor Michelle Lujan Grisham,
* Minnesota Lieutenant Governor Peggy Flanagan, and
* U.S. Senator Amy Klobuchar of Minnesota.

Jordan James Harvill, the National Program Director for Advance Native Political Leadership, provided an insightful overview on the State of Native Representation. Thank you to everyone who joined us during this wonderful celebration! [Sign up](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=75e35a1738&e=d6c5c7d7ec) to receive the DNC Native Coalitions Newsletter for important updates and events.
---
|
---
| **DNC STATEMENT ON FILIPINO HISTORY MONTH** _As Filipino American History Month continues, DNC Chair Jaime Harrison and AAPI Caucus Chair Bel Leong-Hong released the following statement:_ “This month, we celebrate the unique history and contributions of Filipino Americans to the United States. From the cannery workers in Alaska and farm workers in the Pacific Northwest who fought for workers’ rights and fair wages, to the Filipino frontline workers who helped power our country through the pandemic, Filipino Americans have been integral to our country’s growth, health, and prosperity. Today and every day, we celebrate the history and culture of Filipino Americans and honor the sacrifices they have made to our country.”
---

| **President Biden Issues Executive Order on Safe, Secure, and Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence** President Biden issued a landmark [Executive Order](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=7c0a0ba589&e=d6c5c7d7ec) to ensure that America leads the way in seizing the promise and managing the risks of artificial intelligence (AI). The Executive Order establishes new standards for AI safety and security, protects Americans’ privacy, advances equity and civil rights, stands up for consumers and workers, promotes innovation and competition, advances American leadership around the world, and more.
The Executive Order directs the following actions:
* Protecting Americans’ privacy
* Advancing equity and civil rights
* Standing up for consumers, patients, and students
* Supporting workers
* Promoting innovation and competition
* Advancing American leadership abroad
* Ensuring responsible and effective government use of AI

clean_body: A note from DNC's Political Director Brencia Berry | | | | | | | Hello everyone, It’s election season! As many of you may have seen, I am stepping into a new here at the DNC as the Political Director. I am ready to work hand in hand with you as we aim to elect Democrats up and down the ballot. With that in mind, we are in full swing mobilizing voters in key states ahead of the 2023 elections in Virginia, Kentucky, Mississippi, Louisiana, and Pennsylvania. With every seat in the Virginia Senate and House of Delegates up for grabs in this cycle, the stakes of these races couldn't be higher with Governor Youngkin ready and waiting to sign extreme legislation into law should Republicans gain control of both chambers. You can find a phone banking opportunity near you and canvassing opportunities in Virginia . We really need your help, below you’ll find ways to get involved in the upcoming election and be a vital part of the movement to get out the vote in 2023. Your voice carries immense power, and together we can ensure every eligible voter's voice is heard. Below, you will find ways you can do your part in securing wins for Democrats in Virginia. Please take a moment and sign up for a volunteer shift below and review some additional updates from our Political and Coalitions teams. Sincerely, Brencia Berry | | | ICYMI: VICE PRESIDENT KAMALA HARRIS INTERVIEW ON 60 MINUTES Last night, Vice President Kamala Harris spoke with CBS’s 60 Minutes. NBC Contributor Anthony tweeted "VP Harris is on her A game in this 60 Minutes interview—sharp, crisp, charming. Easily the best TV interview of her tenure." The Vice President covered a range of topics, showing strong and thoughtful leadership, sweeping knowledge of multiple policy areas, and clear focus on what is at stake in the 2024 election and how we're going to win: "Fight for Our Freedoms" College Tour Gun violence, voting rights, reproductive freedom, climate change Foreign policy and conflict abroad Ways this admin has delivered on healthcare, support for small businesses and creating jobs This election - talking about what is at stake and how we're going to win Find highlights of the interview below: VP Leading on Key Issues Issues: VP's confidence that "we're going to win" in 2024: David Rothkopf tweet on VP's work: | | VIRGINIA VOLUNTEER OPPORTUNITIES | | Phone Banking Making phone calls is one of the most impactful methods for voter outreach. Through direct, one-on-one conversations with voters, we can address questions, provide clarity on candidates' platforms, and encourage voter turnout. Canvassing The Democratic Party of Virginia is knocking on doors to help get out the vote and inform residents of the importance of the upcoming election. Canvassing is a great opportunity for those looking to get involved in person. | | Kentucky Dems GOTV Phonebank We are phone banking to talk to voters and gain support for Governor Beshear and the down ballot candidates running in the 2023 election! When you sign up, we'll send you info on our script and how to use the Hubdialer system, and you'll be on your way! We can't thank you enough for committing to join the team and impact this critical election. | "SIGN UP HERE" | | Make Calls to Get Out the Vote in Mississippi! Support Brandon Presley in Mississippi as we get into the final week of GOTV! This election is going to be close and we need your help to knock on doors, make phone calls, and talk to voters this year. We'll be there, rain or shine! | "SIGN UP HERE" | | UAW DEAL / DNC AT THE PICKET LINE | DNC Chair Jaime Harrison with UAW Local 2250 President Katie Deatherage and DNC members in Wentzville, MO. | Across the country members of the United Auto Workers have been making sacrifices and walking picket lines in the fight for fair agreements. Six weeks ago the UAW launched a historic Stand Up Strike which has now led to tentative agreements covering 150,000 workers at America’s Big Three automakers. The deals include the biggest gains workers have seen in decades: salary increases, cost of living adjustments, and the elimination of tiered positions. The solidarity and dedication to securing a fair share for America’s autoworkers is a testament to the power of unions and collective bargaining. Read President Biden’s statement on the UAW’s tentative agreement with , , and During the DNC Fall Meeting in St. Louis, Missouri, Chairman Jaime Harrison, along with more than 100 DNC members, joined the workers of UAW Local 2250 on the picket line. Chairman Harrison Interview: | | LGBTQ+ LEADERS ENDORSE JOE BIDEN AND KAMALA HARRIS The following is a statement from Biden-Harris Campaign Manager Julie Chavez Rodriguez on today’s announcement of the historic joint endorsement by Human Rights Campaign PAC (HRC PAC), Equality PAC, and the National Center for Transgender Equality Action Fund (NCTE AF): "Next year’s election will determine whether LGBTQ+ Americans have more freedoms or less. Across the country, MAGA Republicans are hell-bent on taking away LGBTQ+ Americans' hard-fought freedoms and are using our fellow Americans’ identities for political warfare. It’s shameful and not who we are as a country. The stakes of this election could not be higher for LGBTQ+ Americans, and President Biden and Vice President Harris are committed to fighting for every American’s fundamental freedoms. We are deeply honored to earn this historic, unified endorsement from the nation’s leading LGBTQ+ groups. With their support, we will activate the more than 60 million equality voters nationwide to reelect President Biden and Vice President Harris, and equality legislators up and down the ballot." On October 10, Equality PAC, Human Rights Campaign PAC (HRC PAC), and the National Center for Transgender Equality Action Fund (NCTE AF) endorsed Biden-Harris 2024 – the first time the groups have jointly endorsed a presidential ticket. This endorsement comes ahead of National Coming Out Day and amidst an unprecedented spike in anti-LGBTQ+ state legislation, with more than 550 bills introduced in 43 states, and more than 80 signed into law — more than doubling last year, which was previously the worst year on record. In their endorsement, leaders of these groups highlighted President Biden and Vice President Harris’ actions to strengthen protections for LGTBQ+ Americans, and their steadfast commitment to passing additional federal legislation to strengthen LGBTQ+ rights. Love this! @JoeBiden and @KamalaHarris represent unity, equality, and hope – and they will never stop fighting until all LGBTQ+ folks are welcomed, loved, and celebrated. Excited to work alongside @HRC and @HRCPresident to finish the job! : We’ve seen how much of a difference four years can make in the fight for full equality — that’s why we’re endorsing President Biden and Vice President Harris for re-election. Let’s continue to move forward with the Biden-Harris administration. #EqualityIsWorthVotingFor : BREAKING: Equality PAC is proud to join @HRC in endorsing the Biden-Harris ticket in 2024. #LGBTQ rights are on the ballot and @JoeBiden and @KamalaHarris are the only candidates we can put our faith and trust in next year. #EqualityIsWorthVotingFor : Today, we proudly endorse Biden-Harris for 2024! President Biden & Vice President Harris have been champions for LGBTQ+ rights, securing historic victories. Let's protect our freedoms & support pro-equality candidates. Together, we can ensure a future free from discrimination! : Biden's reelection is critical because his administration has been strongly supporting transgender Americans. The 2024 election stakes are incredibly high. @NCTEActionFund will be making sure trans people get out the vote! | | DNC STATEMENT ON HISPANIC HERITAGE MONTH DNC Chair Jaime Harrison and DNC Hispanic Caucus Chair Iris Martinez released the following statement marking Hispanic Heritage Month: “This Hispanic Heritage Month, we celebrate the diversity of the Hispanic and Latino communities and honor the countless contributions that they have made throughout the history of our nation. As a country built by immigrants, we cherish the activism and sacrifices that Latinos have made to ensure that our country lives up to its ideals of freedom, liberty, and equality for all. From fighting for a more just immigration system to marching for workers’ rights, Latinos have made this country a better nation for all Americans." | "FULL STATEMENT" | | | | DNC STATEMENT ON INDIGENOUS PEOPLES’ DAY | | On Indigenous Peoples’ Day, the DNC released a to “honor Indigenous Peoples of the 574 federally recognized tribes as well as Native Hawaiians and Native Pacific Islanders for their countless contributions to our society.” During the DNC’s annual Indigenous Peoples Day Celebration, the DNC Native Caucus’ Chair Clara Pratte and Secretary/Treasurer Ruth Anna Buffalo introduced three surprise guests who talked about the importance of engaging Native communities: New Mexico Governor Michelle Lujan Grisham, Minnesota Lieutenant Governor Peggy Flanagan, and U.S. Senator Amy Klobuchar of Minnesota. Jordan James Harvill, the National Program Director for Advance Native Political Leadership, provided an insightful overview on the State of Native Representation. Thank you to everyone who joined us during this wonderful celebration! to receive the DNC Native Coalitions Newsletter for important updates and events. | | DNC STATEMENT ON FILIPINO HISTORY MONTH As Filipino American History Month continues, DNC Chair Jaime Harrison and AAPI Caucus Chair Bel Leong-Hong released the following statement: “This month, we celebrate the unique history and contributions of Filipino Americans to the United States. From the cannery workers in Alaska and farm workers in the Pacific Northwest who fought for workers’ rights and fair wages, to the Filipino frontline workers who helped power our country through the pandemic, Filipino Americans have been integral to our country’s growth, health, and prosperity. Today and every day, we celebrate the history and culture of Filipino Americans and honor the sacrifices they have made to our country.” | "FULL STATEMENT" | | GETTING OUT THE YOUTH VOTE IN VIRGINIA | | | The DNC is working with the Virginia coordinated campaign and key target races to uplift and support youth and campus vote efforts. We know that youth turnout - especially on some of these key campuses are going to be key to Democratic success. Wanting to get involved to help get out the youth vote in the final stretch? Call young voters with Blue Future, Grassroots Dems HQ, and Voters of Tomorrow: Text young voters with Blue Future, Grassroots Dems HQ, and Voters of Tomorrow: Based in or near Virginia? Email Eve at mailto:levensone@dnc.org to get connection to a college campus in a key district that could use additional support on election day! You can check out more of the incredible youth vote and youth-led work happening in this . | | President Biden Issues Executive Order on Safe, Secure, and Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence President Biden issued a landmark to ensure that America leads the way in seizing the promise and managing the risks of artificial intelligence (AI). The Executive Order establishes new standards for AI safety and security, protects Americans’ privacy, advances equity and civil rights, stands up for consumers and workers, promotes innovation and competition, advances American leadership around the world, and more. The Executive Order directs the following actions: Protecting Americans’ privacy Advancing equity and civil rights Standing up for consumers, patients, and students Supporting workers Promoting innovation and competition Advancing American leadership abroad Ensuring responsible and effective government use of AI Tune in to watch President Biden and Vice President Harris deliver remarks on artificial intelligence. | | | Follow our socials! | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Copyright © 2023 DNC Community Engagement, All rights reserved._ This is a test distribution list. ## Kelly Ayotte: Keep New Hampshire safe, prosperous and free
---
| | [October 29, 2023](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/c2Ok0uDva/c?w=e1sVdFZu8nZRVUvkliFhqOBqpzlr0E7omMdlhLTQ7TM.)
---
| | I’m running for Governor because I am worried that New Hampshire is one election away from becoming Massachusetts — from becoming something we are not. Live Free or Die is more than a motto — it’s a way of life. Here, we know that our cherished freedoms set us apart from the rest of the country. We must fight to keep our state a shining beacon of liberty. My husband, Joe, and I have New Hampshire in our blood. We were born in Nashua and raised our kids here. We know firsthand that this is the best state in America to raise a family. Our country, and especially New Hampshire, has blessed our family. That is why we believe so strongly in public service. I had the privilege of serving as a murder prosecutor at the state Attorney General’s Office, as our attorney general, and as New Hampshire’s United States senator. Joe served our nation as an A-10 pilot in the U.S. Air Force. Our daughter, Kate, who is now a cadet at the Air Force Academy, is following in his footsteps. As your Governor, I will work to ensure that New Hampshire doesn’t become Massachusetts North. I’ll be guided by a firm commitment to keeping our state safe, prosperous and free. My top priority will be making our communities and neighborhoods safe. That starts with fighting to change the failed 2018 bail reform law, which has resulted in a revolving door of dangerous criminals walking out of jail. Violent offenders shouldn’t be able to stalk our streets and perpetrate more crimes against law-abiding Granite Staters. We must fully support our brave law enforcement officers. They protect us 24/7, no matter how dangerous the situation. We need to make sure that they have the resources and support they need to protect our communities. New Hampshire is currently down 77 state troopers — I’ll work to fill that gap. Tragically, the fentanyl crisis continues to devastate New Hampshire families. Record levels of drugs are pouring over our country’s southern border, then transported north to Lowell and Lawrence. Massachusetts drug traffickers send these drugs to New Hampshire, killing our citizens. I will work side by side with law enforcement to dismantle this pipeline and send a strong message to fentanyl dealers: if you bring your poison into our state, you will face the toughest prison sentences in the country. To keep New Hampshire safe, we must also enforce our immigration laws and never allow sanctuary city policies to be implemented. We need look no further than Massachusetts to see that sanctuary policies will make New Hampshire less safe. The Governor of Massachusetts (who supports one of my Democrat opponents, Mayor Joyce Craig) has had to declare a state of emergency due to the influx of illegal immigrants in that state. We can’t let that happen here. We have a clear economic advantage over our neighbors — no income, sales, or estate taxes. As Governor, I will keep the Granite State prosperous, and not only protect our New Hampshire Advantage but strengthen it. That means reducing energy and housing costs and cutting burdensome job regulations that hinder growth. From top to bottom, I will scrutinize all aspects of state government to make it more efficient and customer friendly. Finally, in the Live Free or Die spirit, I will protect our cherished personal freedoms — starting with parents. Parents have a right to decide what is best for their children — period. I will put parents in the driver’s seat of their child’s education. We will work to pass, and I will proudly sign, a Parental Bill of Rights that empowers parents. I will fight for universal education freedom because every child should have the ability to attend the school that best fits their needs, regardless of their parents’ income or where they live. I will also personally work to recruit more great teachers to our state and fight for better teacher pay. Together, we will work to ensure our kids receive the best education in the country based on their individual needs. New Hampshire is at a crossroads. Governor Chris Sununu is an excellent leader who has worked hard to keep New Hampshire strong and improve our quality of life. But with the wrong leadership, we are only one election away from losing our New Hampshire Advantage and becoming Massachusetts. I will not let that happen. Together, we can protect our Live Free or Die values and ensure that New Hampshire remains safe, prosperous and free.
---

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-dmp [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-dmp]
As an immigrant to America, I know firsthand how difficult it can be for working families to get by.
But I've also seen the incredible opportunities that are only possible in America — and now, I'm running for Senate to safeguard those opportunities that self-serving politicians like my opponent, Rick Scott, want to destroy
If you're ready to pitch in and help this team reach our critical $150,000 end-of-October goal, you can click here to split a gift between my campaign and Serve America — but first, I hope you'll let me explain why I'm fighting to keep the American Dream alive. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-dmp]
My American Dream came true because my mother left our home in Ecuador and bravely brought my sisters and me to this country to give us a chance to build the future she dreamed of.
My American Dream came true because my mother worked day and night to afford rent in our one room apartment and provide us with a better education, a better home, and a better future.
My American Dream came true because I was able to go from working a minimum wage job to help my mom make ends meet to serving in Congress.
My American Dream came true because I had a strong community to lean on, opportunities to grow, and the right to live my life as I wanted.
I'm fighting to protect those same opportunities, which are now out of reach for far too many working families.

# **Financial Freedom in America**
# **will soon be gone!**

**The 'Digital Dollar' is now a reality.** On November 15th, 2022, the Federal Reserve announced they are now testing the **'digital dollar'.** They'll be joined by major banks like Citigroup, HSBC, Mastercard, and Wells Fargo. **And you should be scared!** The 'digital dollar' puts all your money in the hands of the government. They'll be able to....
* **Know what's in your accounts and what you buy**

name: American Action News
subject: The decline of American Citizenship
body:
This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
My name is Kyle Murnen and I am the Director of Online Learning at Hillsdale College

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z383pudcla0lcm835gee50o2uolheoc7n692fbao_rp22sh2s8i66p70stjmcob6chh2bs) Dear Friend,

My name is Kyle Murnen and I am the Director of Online Learning at Hillsdale College, where we offer free online courses to anyone who wishes to learn.

**One of our top-rated courses, "American Citizenship and Its Decline," is taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson and is based on his book _The Dying Citizen_.**

This course argues that at the heart of America's current crises are symptoms of a far larger problem that afflicts the West: the loss of freedom and political power of the citizen.

Dr. Hanson frames this problem by first explaining the history of citizenship in the West and by reminding us how rare it is in human history to have governments that are created and controlled by the people.

To maintain this type of government requires a robust and self-reliant middle class, clearly defined and enforced borders, national autonomy, and confidence in our way of life.

Yet today, the middle class is disappearing under enormous economic strains, the distinction between citizen and resident is being blurred by open borders, and pre-civilizational tribalism is dividing Americans into a variety of identity groups.

These problems are being aggravated by top-down pressures from an unelected bureaucratic class that uses judicial, executive, and legislative powers to overwhelm the citizen.

Finally, globalism poses a historic challenge to national sovereignty, as many of today's elites seek to replace American laws and independence with international bodies, often without the consent of our elected representatives or the people they serve.

The course, however, concludes on a hopeful note: Citizens still hold the key to revitalizing our traditions of empowered citizenship and regaining control over our government.

So, enroll today in this free course, "American Citizenship and Its Decline," with Victor Davis Hanson. You can embark on this journey with us to learn about these threats to our rights as citizens and how to combat them.

Click the secure link below to start today.

**[https://online.hillsdale.edu/register/american-citizenship-and-its-decline](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4iu2q1vom8ibdb9d948pcfr02i9aj0qp5asucgo_rp22sh2s8i66p70stjmcob6chh2bs)
**

Best regards,
Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College |

| American Action News

Instead, I want to share a bit about myself, and talk about the person I believe is best suited to serve as California’s next U.S. Senator: **Adam Schiff.**
I’m a lifelong Californian. Born in LA, raised in Sherman Oaks, and graduated from Van Nuys High School.
My parents encouraged me to be politically active from a young age. My mom, Jane Gordon, even ran for Congress here before I was born.
Recently, I’ve been advocating for AI Regulation, one of the key issues at the heart of the SAG-AFTRA strike. And so has Adam. He stood by the 160,000 members of our union. But he was also right to call the entertainment industry the “tip of the spear,” warning that job loss from AI could impact not just us actors, but so many other Americans as well.
**And it wasn’t just lip service. Adam has joined the picket line. And time after time, he’s voted and introduced legislation to make the economy work for everyone.**
I also binged Adam’s entire audiobook, _Midnight In Washington_ , about the work he did to protect our democracy from those who were trying to dismantle it. And in my opinion, he deserves to be rewarded for putting himself in the line of fire.
I know Adam Schiff will be a Senator who will _get things done._ But first, **we need to help him win this election**. So Derek, I’m personally asking:

# Scary Good News: Halloween Politics - No Tricks, Just Treats! 🎃
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=21e7407d66&e=0a12281e0e)
Boo! 👻 👻 👻
It's that spooky time of year when ghouls and goblins come out to play, and politicians try to scare us with their campaign promises. But fear not, because we're here to bring a little Halloween humor to your inbox.
🎃 The "Mummy-fication" of Bureaucracy: Are you tired of dealing with red tape? We promise that if elected, we'll unwrap the mysteries of bureaucracy faster than you can say "mummy." No more haunting delays – it's time to free the paperwork!
👻 The "Candy Corn-troversy" of Our Time: We know that candy corn can be quite divisive. But here's the real question: Is it a trick or a treat? Our campaign is dedicated to finding common ground – and maybe even the perfect candy corn recipe that will unite the nation. Join us on the quest for candy harmony!
🧛 The "Vampire Energy" Crisis: Vampires may suck the life out of their victims, but what about those energy bills that drain our wallets? We pledge to tackle the real "vampire energy" crisis by making your utility bills less terrifying and more budget-friendly. Energy-efficient policies – no garlic required!
🦇 The "Zombie Voting" Phenomenon: Ever heard of the "zombie vote"? It's when your coffee-deprived neighbor stumbles to the polling station, half-asleep, and casts their vote. Our campaign is dedicated to making sure every vote counts, even if it's cast by the undead. Democracy – it's alive and well!
🕷️ The "Spider-web of Bureaucracy": We'll cut through the spider-web of bureaucracy to make government more efficient. No more getting tangled in endless forms and procedures. Our campaign will ensure that government services are as straightforward as an eight-legged spider's path.
Remember, we're all about treats, not tricks, and our campaign promises to bring a little laughter and light-heartedness to the crazy world of politics.
From all of us here at the Roca for Congress Team, have a spooktacular Halloween. Please stay safe and well as you head out trick-or-treating with your families tonight! 🎃 🍭 🎃 🍭 🎃 🍭
Yours in humor,

body:
I’m sure you’re getting bombarded with messages (trust me, I am too), so I appreciate you reading this.

Tonight is our big end-of-month deadline, and I want to reach out one last time personally. Will you chip in whatever you can to help us hit our $5,000 online grassroots goal before midnight? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_bax_kt_q4]

Look, I jumped into this race because I believe the American people deserve better. The People's House is in turmoil because MAGA Republicans are putting Donald Trump’s demands and their extreme agenda ahead of the issues that matter to working folks and families — like safety from gun violence and preserving our freedoms.

Instead of doing the right thing, people like my opponent, Anthony D'Esposito, are bending over backward to meet every demand of the MAGA GOP and their special interest donors.

That's not leadership — that's cowardice. And with your help, we can defeat D’Esposito, flip this battleground seat blue next year, and bring sanity back to Washington with a Democratic majority.

And that’s why it’s so important for us to hit our fundraising numbers. Let’s work together to turn our people-powered movement into an unstoppable force that can win.

So, this will be my last ask this month: Can I count on you to chip in before midnight? Here’s the best link to give: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_bax_kt_q4]

Thanks again,
Kevin
Sent from my iPhone

Fellow American, I know you’re busy this Halloween, but this email could not wait.

**Here is the short version:**
**I’m up against the clock on my FIRST monthly deadline since becoming Speaker of the House. All eyes are on me, and I cannot afford to fall short of the goals set in front of me. In the next 15 minutes,**[**can you step forward with an emergency donation to have my back?**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35881%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=oddFCukP8H%2bMa1gKGEDQ4Q&sysid=1)

[** DONATE **](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35882%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=D414sZcw32W4ltvvDLlRxQ&sysid=1)
**Here is the long version:**
Democrats have already raked in MILLIONS in fundraising dollars this week and are trying to turn me into the next boogeyman,**but I refuse to let America fall to their woke vision.**

[**Nancy Pelosi is going to call in every favor she can to boot me and take back the majority -_which means we need to show FORCE._**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35883%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ix2naBeJLyEBAX2VoCXhDg&sysid=1)

If Republicans are going to keep the House in 2024 and expand the majority, we need to support every single candidate running in a swing district. [**Your Republican gift today will ensure we expand the majority and financially support conservatives in vulnerable districts.**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35884%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=wbFG1EC%2f32iz1EEuGqh7bw&sysid=1)

[**I’m asking for your help today.**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35895%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=dTMm9mjnwkh3X8ldLDIv0g&sysid=1)

[** EMERGENCY DONATE **](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35896%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=TXqEQJjMi0rWstrE2XnQ4A&sysid=1)

If Democrats take back power, they’re going to go wild...

I believe in faith, family, and freedom - but those very foundations of our country are under ATTACK.

Before the month is up at midnight, [**I need your immediate help.**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35897%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=hjjNapfeFp4HCqZlM%2b56IQ&sysid=1)

For America,

Mike Johnson
Speaker of the House

| **_MIKE JOHNSON_**

We Have A Speaker! | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/43fb3e5078c3/conforti-for-congress-8388764?e=25f4fa3311)
---
| | |
---
| | | Dear Peter,

After a long and painful process, we have a new Speaker of the House. Three weeks, fourteen candidate, and four nominations later Mike Johnson (R-LA) was unanimously voted into the position.

While I didn't know him previously, I like what I have seen since he has taken the gavel. Mike Johnson is a constitutional lawyer with a strong faith in God. He does not mince words and is not afraid to call out the corruption in this White House. Already, he has taken steps to pare back the excessive spending of the Left and begun to get things done.

The fact that he was voted into the position without any opposition from the Republicans shows that our party can align and work together. Much remains to be seen but indications are that he has the ability to unify the party. Republicans working together is a powerful force - and is exactly what the Democrats fear.

Of course, Sean Casten has made statements against Mike Johnson, calling him an extremist. Typical. That is all he has - there is nothing more he can say that is bad about Mike Johnson. Mike works with the interests of the American people at the forefront of his decisions, which is a refreshing change from the last 3 years.

Now more than ever it is important to strengthen the Republican presence in Congress, so that we can continue to work for what is best for Americans. Help me get to Congress and push policies that are pro-American and will improve our living standards.

Please consider making a contribution to my campaign to help me get to Congress. No amount is too small.

[](https://conforti4congress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7fd34b7284bf7f5e87a4e45e5&id=dfa77c04a4&e=25f4fa3311)

Your support is greatly appreciated.
Stay strong!
---
| Thank you,

Niki Conforti

name: Mike Johnson
subject: America is the greatest country on earth
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY MIKE JOHNSON FOR LOUISIANA
body:
I believe to my core that the most important things in life are God, family, and pride in our country. These are the values that guide me and shape my life.

|
[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zu6q97khrfa5jbo9k7vfta9jk3loorts89jsjjpo_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t6ekr3asjl6ejn9ctiekoj79hnmmrqbd5mmkpbfc5jmprr7dt26irrb83k6mh7fpjm6nh60oj6chg64or7qm99f44jipbp75ul2kbt0l0nq8a9f5uiak9lfk2hil9iasblmv8ncdf0a6alb8j0c9j68o36chhiasblmvb7fdbieoqjbojl6dpiasblmvarac9kmlqrbp9lmgqb3cp5e5qrflhk6mo78d5n6equ4d5nm79r3kthqep238h1e8he4933cjgeepr5c9j6coh5u)
---
Fellow American,

The most important things in life are faith, family, and freedom. That's not just a slogan, these happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I am fighting every day to preserve them.

**Faith.** Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people.

**Family.** Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way.

**Freedom.** It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I’ve devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress.

clean_body: We can beat those who want to maintain a status quo if we stick together. | | Peter, Leading with courage and a love for all of humanity has always put a target on my back by those who want to reverse the progress our movement has built. It’s no surprise to me that I would have an opponent in this race , but I am amazed that my first opponent abandoned his Senate run challenging MAGA extremist and Trump sycophant Josh Hawley, five months in, to challenge our movement. We can beat those who want to maintain a status quo if we stick together. ** Many of the same corporate PAC’s who’ve sought out to defeat our movement are going to pour money into this new challenger’s campaign. These are the PAC’s invested in making the rich richer, protecting those in power from true accountability, and silencing anyone who speaks up for the human rights of all people. These PAC’s might have money, but we have something way more valuable: people power. Our movement is made up of everyday people, many living paycheck-to-check, many unfairly targeted by our criminal legal system, many struggling to afford healthcare, and many just trying to make our world a better place. We have a bold, unwavering progressive vision for the future and when we work together, we will make a difference. We won this seat together to represent the people of St. Louis in 2020 on a bold, progressive vision, and every day since being sworn into Congress I have prioritized the needs and wellbeing of my constituents. It’s why I won last year and intend to win in 2024: not for me, but for the people who want to do more than just survive in this country, they want to thrive in it. I don’t take any money from corporate PACs, because our movement for transformative change should be people-powered. And right now we’re up against a new challenger and an end-of-month deadline. To return to Congress and continue to be the bold leader our communities need, we have to demonstrate our power now. body:
I’m hoping you’ll consider pitching in a generous gift today!
