| | | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zh1c8bmippqe07m6von61vgfj20shvngk6av25fg_rp22sh2s8i66p70stjmaoj1c1h2bs)
---

Hi Friend,

Whether you've been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate, I couldn't be more grateful to have a chance to connect with you.

Now, I think it's important to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zcebs78imfqvokbnuch1ae84nco6h0kkp5nvfeu8_rp22sh2s8i66p70stjmaoj1c1h2bs "Once youâ€TMve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | | | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zv6hlaoi1o4ect7qeg43hfidu8mjig2tfrec6odg_rp22sh2s8i66p70stjmaoj1c1h2bs)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**
---
| | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zvsv797bmd18qjho294bi4d4r6fldguo10jg0qpg_rp22sh2s8i66p70stjmaoj1c1h2bs)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2ziki311at08n8u2e6gc4t5o9lhngko243qp5g8d8_rp22sh2s8i66p70stjmaoj1c1h2bs)
---

I launched my campaign for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class.

Now, I just completed my **SECOND** debate, and I need a **SURGE** of support to keep the momentum strong in order to continue sharing this message across America! **[It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!>>](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zodrikh91qdtah2j0gsklgfo4e4j6th63vpp0m7g_rp22sh2s8i66p70stjmaoj1c1h2bs "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate.")**

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will showcase the tremendous momentum we have gained since last quarter!

**I 'm hoping you'll consider pitching in a generous gift today!**

**[Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the power of OUR movement?>>](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2ziocq30qopscrtn0c3vre83h8l02mn3tcjrf7c9o_rp22sh2s8i66p70stjmaoj1c1h2bs "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate.")**

---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zlsslaai6id4ij6qd83ik6b5r2ta4i7biuas2kmo_rp22sh2s8i66p70stjmaoj1c1h2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

I OPENED ANOTHER LOATHSOME EMAIL this morning—this one from a maga-maniac who was foaming at the mouth after listening to one of Rural Americans United’s new radio ads.
As you may have heard, we just launched our $350,000, 14-month advertising campaign. From now through at least the end of next year, Central Washington will be flooded with 20,000 radio spots promoting traditional Democratic values. In an area that’s been smothered for years under a blanket of smarmy Republican propaganda, the ads are already inspiring enthusiasm, and more than that—hope. In the two weeks since the advertisements began running, 2,000 new subscribers have signed up for this newsletter; and hits on [RAU’s website](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/cbOk2MYjZ/c?w=z5jPcpa1uX8F9OSCQnSrql0i2uhr_SjghP7yNjH3Zto.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucnVyYWxhbWVyaWNhbnN1bml0ZWQub3JnLyIsInIiOiIxYjdlNDdjZC04Yjc2LTQ1NTktOWM1YS0yYWU4ZmJiZmVlNWEiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ) have more than tripled!
But if RAU’s campaign to emphasize Democratic ideals (like public education, healthcare access, restoring aging infrastructure, job creation, immigration reform, and support for unions and veterans) is inspiring hope in Central Washington, it is also bringing fear and fury to MAGA worshippers who oppose those values. Here is the RAU radio ad that so enraged the wingnut who sent this morning’s unhinged email:
Tired of not getting paid what you’re worth? Tired of rich corporate CEOs hogging America’s wealth and leaving crumbs on the table for workers? Tired of Republicans trying to take money away from your kids’ education to support rich private schools? Sick and tired of Republicans failing to take action on immigration reforms that would protect our economy and the immigrants that support it? Help Democrats make America fair again. Go to [www.ruralamericansunited.org](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/cbOk2MYjZ/c?w=rBbKjav41vid5eVND945wnQR5cTB9GK4NqQ-rMFrzMc.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cDovL3d3dy5ydXJhbGFtZXJpY2Fuc3VuaXRlZC5vcmciLCJyIjoiMWI3ZTQ3Y2QtOGI3Ni00NTU5LTljNWEtMmFlOGZiYmZlZTVhIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0) to learn more. Paid for by Rural Americans United, not endorsed or approved by any candidate.
The vicious message we received in reply is typical of the kind of over-the-top violent language and intimidation tactics Republicans have been using this political season in local election races across our region. It’s not enough to just tell you the email was particularly ugly; we present it uncensored; you’ve got to see it to believe it:
So your radio ad says that you guys would take care of immigration laws?!You dumb fuck liberal shit bags have already screwed that up look at your dumb fuck potato head puppet for a president that has the southern border wide fucking open! Maybe you should pull your head out of your loose drippy a****** and see the light of day and realize that Democrats are complete fuckstains that are destroying this country! Kiss my ball sack you worthless pieces of shit
This kind of violent language is not unique; it is standard operating procedure in the ever-escalating intimidation playbook being updated constantly by the head of the Republican crime family. It’s taking place nationally—remember Trump’s recent threat that U.S. Joint Chiefs of Staff Gen. Mark Milley should be [executed for treason](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/cbOk2MYjZ/c?w=i8U0_7wU2zh1DY9zZwFTMigggeXmmbkdEfnkdmHeh5U.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cudGhlYXRsYW50aWMuY29tL2lkZWFzL2FyY2hpdmUvMjAyMy8wOS90cnVtcC1taWxsZXktZXhlY3V0aW9uLWluY2l0ZW1lbnQtdmlvbGVuY2UvNjc1NDM1LyIsInIiOiIxYjdlNDdjZC04Yjc2LTQ1NTktOWM1YS0yYWU4ZmJiZmVlNWEiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ); and death threats against Republican congresspersons who refused to vote for a MAGA sociopath as their speaker. And it has been happening all too frequently in Central Washington, particularly this year.
For example:

* According to the [Cascade Advocate](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/cbOk2MYjZ/c?w=0KC94Px_8vPIeUTeL9-OJEPozuLAZk4V-hM_MuOZlOI.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubndwcm9ncmVzc2l2ZS5vcmcvd2VibG9nLzIwMjMvMDkvbWVtby10by13YXNoaW5ndG9uLXN0YXRlcy1yaWdodC13aW5nLWhhcmFzc21lbnQtaXMtbm90LWFjY291bnRhYmlsaXR5Lmh0bWwiLCJyIjoiMWI3ZTQ3Y2QtOGI3Ni00NTU5LTljNWEtMmFlOGZiYmZlZTVhIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0), Republican operatives used right-wing media to shower Yakima’s elected mayor with hundreds of threatening messages last month after she attempted to protect shoppers from harassment at a local Walmart. The intimidation against the mayor included doxing (revealing personal information about a person online) and sexual harassment. “In orchestrating this bombardment of an elected official’s personal mobile number with angrily-worded text messages, [Republicans] are seeking to intimidate an elected official so she doesn’t cross them in the future,” the Advocate wrote. “The goal is not to respectfully disagree (which can be done through official channels), it’s to make [the mayor] feel bad ... to inflict distress and emotional suffering.”

* A local nonpartisan city council member had one of her campaign signs stolen from her yard this month. A few days later, the sign appeared in her across-the-street neighbor’s yard—with FUCK YOU written on it in large letters. When the councilwoman asked the neighbors about the sign, they told her to “fuck off” because it was their “constitutional right.”

* After supporters and protesters demonstrated for and against family-friendly drag shows in the Tri-Cities this spring, the Emerald of Siam restaurant in Richland was [vandalized and the owners received death threats](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/cbOk2MYjZ/c?w=pYi373qtpnGRKo5BuLwTXaHpmmF4Z4jo4VX6SpymE-Q.).

* In August, incumbent Pasco City Councilman Irving Brown Sr., the only Black councilman in Pasco and the only Black candidate running for the council, had a campaign sign defaced with racist messages. It wasn’t the first time the issue of race has been raised recently, the [Tri-Cities Herald](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/cbOk2MYjZ/c?w=a7ooiPYj7JcmJ1JNtxhsDmLmwkSp0aJ0UT656GoXLmU.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cudHJpLWNpdHloZXJhbGQuY29tL25ld3MvbG9jYWwvYXJ0aWNsZTI3ODY2MzUyOS5odG1sI3N0b3J5bGluaz1jcHkiLCJyIjoiMWI3ZTQ3Y2QtOGI3Ni00NTU5LTljNWEtMmFlOGZiYmZlZTVhIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0) reported. Late last year, a local newspaper publisher voiced frustration that the city council had “given away” a retiring council member's seat to “an African American.”

Republicans have been adding pages to their anti-democratic playbook for years. Ronald Reagan made it OK to favor the wealthy over the working class, Trump made it OK to lie, cheat, steal, bully, intimidate and abuse power to force his agenda on others.
Nowhere is the tactics of MAGA more evident than in rural America. MAGA knows their ideology is not shared with the majority of the American people. So they have perfected a strategy to force it on us. They have only two tactics: disinformation and intimidation. Both are highly effective, and no place is more vulnerable than rural America. Rural Americans United is beginning to shine a light on those despicable MAGA tactics: by providing accurate, honest information to the people of Central Washington, and by refusing to be intimidated by MAGA threats of violence. We are committed to restoring a culture of respectful, civil discourse to the politics of our region, and we will never, ever resort to violent words or actions.
—Doug White Founder, Rural Americans United

As you may have heard, we just launched our $350,000, 14-month advertising campaign. In the two weeks since the advertisements began running, 2,000 new subscribers have signed up for this newsletter; and hits on have more than tripled! But if RAU’s campaign to emphasize Democratic ideals (like public education, healthcare access, restoring aging infrastructure, job creation, immigration reform, and support for unions and veterans) is inspiring hope in Central Washington, it is also bringing fear and fury to MAGA worshippers who oppose those values. Here is the RAU radio ad that so enraged the wingnut who sent this morning’s unhinged email: Tired of not getting paid what you’re worth? The vicious message we received in reply is typical of the kind of over-the-top violent language and intimidation tactics Republicans have been using this political season in local election races across our region. Hello Everyone!
My friend Stephanie Trussell, former Illinois Lieutenant Governor candidate, joined me to discuss what is means (and what it is like) to be black in America.
No fancy gibberish or self-inflicted victimhood here: just the *TRUTH* (and some hard truths.)
We covered various topics relating to the experiences of black people in America. We talk about why we are conservative and have been voting Republican for years, [my book](https://substack.com/redirect/7fc8a679-8cb2-43ef-9557-8d62fbfe3486?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), faith, and much more.

Roger Williams is a Christian, conservative, pro-life, and second amendment supporter taking Texas values to Washington, D.C. He is a small business owner with over 45 years of experience and is running for Congress to create economic growth, jobs, and provide strong leadership. His passion for conservative leadership led him to support Republican candidates from the White House to the county courthouse. Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now.

Peter,
Make no mistake: our new GOP opponent, Mitch McConnell, and national Republicans are going to pull out all the stops to flip Pennsylvania. Their determination to win PA's Senate seat could make this the most expensive race in the country.
It's a rare privilege to serve the people of our Commonwealth in the U.S. Senate, and I don't take this responsibility for granted. Pennsylvanians deserve a Senator in Washington working for them and their families. It is an honor that they've trusted me to do just that.
It's why we're working so hard to ensure that we can compete with the flood of dark money the other side is planning to spend against us.

# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=765%2E135344%2E8wI-35)

Friends -
I'm reaching out this morning with a last-ditch request for a contribution to my campaign. I'll be honest with you: today is not an official fundraising deadline, but it is a very important day in our fundraising plan.
Here's how it works: campaigns like ours have to report our numbers each quarter to the FEC (the next one is December 31, 2023). But in between those quarterly FEC deadlines, we have important internal monthly fundraising goals to meet in order to stay on track to defend Michigan's Senate seat for Democrats.
**Our campaign is relying on a large number of individual contributions if we're going to have the resources to win this race,** and our number one source of those individual contributions is through emails like this one.
[**With the hours winding down until October ends, I hope you will chip in before midnight. So I'm asking: Can you make your first online contribution to my Senate campaign before our October fundraising drive ends tonight at midnight? It all really does add up when a bunch of people chip in here and there.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct23.ttRNnI&refcode=em231030-1-30&t=2&akid=765%2E135344%2E8wI-35)**

[**I’d love it if you would consider making your first online contribution to my Senate campaign before our October fundraising drive ends tonight at midnight. I need to introduce myself to the 10 million people in Michigan, and an early introduction could be the difference between winning or losing next year. | I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**

It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**ICYMI: John Teichert joins Fox to discuss tensions in the Middle East**
**Baltimore, MD** \- In case you missed it, Maryland U.S. Senate candidate and retired Brigadier General John Teichert joined Jon Scott to address the rising tensions spreading throughout the Middle East and beyond on Fox News.
[WATCH: ](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=ea90ff52e4&e=1b1fb1ad9f)
[](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=5dfe274b42&e=1b1fb1ad9f)
**“The concern is that the fairly weak, late response from Syria from a couple of nights ago combined with almost an apologetic statement by the Secretary of Defense likely entices Iran instead of deterring Iran,”** Teichert told Fox Reports.
When asked whether or not he believes that there is a “target list” prepared that the U.S. would be willing and prepared to pursue, Teichert responded, **“It’s very wise for the United States to be extremely strong in our outcomes with respect to response to attacks against Americans- and there are several targets that we could hit in Iraq, Syria, Lebanon and elsewhere. And again, my concern is that unless we can demonstrate strength, capability, will, and resolve, it likely just gives a green light to Iran that we are weak, and they can continue to attack through their proxies.”**
Teichert’s comments follow Israeli [ground invasions and air operations](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=41408f9d82&e=1b1fb1ad9f) throughout the Gaza Strip over the weekend. Calls for a ceasefire have increased internationally as anti-Israel protest groups gather on [college campuses](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=825a4d808e&e=1b1fb1ad9f) and[ government property](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=e1d4024f0e&e=1b1fb1ad9f).
When asked about Israel’s war plan in response to international anti-Israel sentiment, John stated in part, **“They (Israelis) care more about Palestinians than Hamas does, but it certainly does play into the Israeli war plans that they need to maintain some level of worldwide support.”**

| |

Hi Friend,

Whether you've been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate, I couldn't be more grateful to have a chance to connect with you.

Now, I think it's important to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zv26buq2k3kvigvq4r490i7kvg4tvgd14hlepif0_rp22sh2s8i66p70stge4ob6cph2bs "Once youâ€TMve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | | | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrf7915ak5e924ovpq6n0ntqkpin0595ac69992o_rp22sh2s8i66p70stge4ob6cph2bs)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**
---
| | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ze8ei2n677m1l1nhhu33736m7seq7k02rr3vs0go_rp22sh2s8i66p70stge4ob6cph2bs)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9nndp588bm2e6jo1vogs3gf4j84isj3so73lvao_rp22sh2s8i66p70stge4ob6cph2bs)
---

I launched my campaign for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class.

Now, I just completed my **SECOND** debate, and I need a **SURGE** of support to keep the momentum strong in order to continue sharing this message across America! **[It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!>>](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zgb9j6vjgaa5q3qq0pvo64843oi7p900a491mrco_rp22sh2s8i66p70stge4ob6cph2bs "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate.")**

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will showcase the tremendous momentum we have gained since last quarter!

**[Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the power of OUR movement?>>](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zsle3utnd3sjdqebimfkiu0ff47u513s6hq0urag_rp22sh2s8i66p70stge4ob6cph2bs "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate.")**

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvdquisig6132o76s20qg2ds98vo1ksjg1vu5hao_rp22sh2s8i66p70stge4ob6cph2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words. | | | | | | I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it. After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: " Don't complain. Do something about it." | | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. Today, we are asking you to join us as we simply [**stand with Israel**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.org/c/7/eyJhaSI6NDkxMDk0ODksImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjpudWxsLCJycSI6IjAyLWIyMzMwNC01YzM0NDAyMTI4MjQ0ZjMxYWViZDE5ZDJlNzdmZjViMSIsInBoIjpudWxsLCJtIjpmYWxzZSwidWkiOiIwIiwidW4iOiIiLCJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9hbGlnbmFjdC5jb20vZ28vc3RhbmQtd2l0aC1pc3JhZWw_bWlkPTQ2NTQ5JmlkPVQxN1VOVHNmWkp0d2tTeVRUQyJ9/R2RrgMWe-KORFzXMnEq8Og) in their hour of need. We are watching as _pro-Hamas_ _celebrations_ occur on city streets around the world and on college campuses, where people are rejoicing in and justifying the horrific attack on civilians in Israel on October 7th. Innocent people were butchered – tortured, raped, mutilated, burned alive, murdered, and kidnapped to Gaza – and too much of the world is blaming Israel. **We want our government and the world to know that Americans stand with Israel.** What does that mean? At its core it means that we support their right to defend their country, their people, and their right to exist. Americans grieve with Israel and we mourn the innocent lives that were so brutally taken. We join Israel in demanding the immediate release of all hostages as well.

[ https://act.katieporter.com/go/14559?t=1001&akid=32361%2E3422442%2EfPl5ft ]Katie Porter for Senate

Derek,

It’s not just Halloween... It's our end of month fundraising deadline!

I know one of those things is a lot more exciting than the other. But
meeting these fundraising goals matters, because:

1. With four months until the primary, meeting these goals directly
determines how much we can spend on digital ads, TV, mailers, and
organizing.
2. Super PACs could come at any moment and run millions of dollars worth
of misleading ads—I’ve had it happen before. We have to be prepared,
and strong fundraising numbers can deter them.
3. Thanks to our robust vote by mail options here in California, folks
start voting in February. Polling shows a third of voters are
undecided, so we have millions of people we need to reach right now.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231031-1?refcode=EMAM23_1_EOM_20231031_V1_F&refcode2=32361_3422442_fPl5ft&akid=32361%2E3422442%2EfPl5ft ]I’m the only Democrat in this race who has never taken a dime from

| | | | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=02e0ac7b7749484bb58827e9e6027186&_e=ks4-OhKbyXzLbU7gEARAP7N6V3nCbrTNh53gR8capx-WebouVLTpc_EM7c-A3TiJr9mfkrkGp_SKG7Nem3mP3HiQkegXH7-OozfdLX_pC45Ccpyw4nQ87Hm03TJ7NMEHIMuHSf2ABHsqaOVKJG-6imrg2nXl4IzD5MfRz9QxPP0RMaY8gB2ufwV7GsywzcfBkkaP38rtHGmwH2x6XNdr_myK6d1t8JKSeQOJxqDyiD6JBM32qJZYQUc-m_qQ-wclYUi94YNDPD29m1rUh6V4oHdXZPLUM1IP1VJfMGEdxMXPJFGC8wOk58Y3EtsCjxzuKBlBdgV6NjtTE7vdfhwLpDm1wwtla5WoWTxU8ft2HauYXlnoAKzYBOgelhJPFwogb__dqIasJFzYfKQc4ePpyZYkIO4LLebrpQcHnm9slMBY-IoR4t-rT0yLXq36lZLvDeDGJ_4n8X1umkKLxxfJhqBBBZXo7f9xyIkbrBjIFRNnt3zZWEgJdvGnRZd8GB0Kmp15p1YSRXa21slX2JueFOFZ6kNKr9ZqgzyJ-yEQfnqcx-v0aHKU8eaR7tPcHgN7_FLo8cIuI3BtCXPPZzolswJxRT1n2XjNsSQGBrNaYrFr-2r4KbnkxAaknyjSkb8y)

| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**

It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words. | | | | | | I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it. After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: " Don't complain. Do something about it." | | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. | | It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor. When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy. When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them. | I launched my campaign for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again. I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country. I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A. | Friends,

I want to begin by expressing my deepest gratitude to all of you who have supported me throughout this presidential campaign. I have been truly honored by the enthusiasm and dedication of all of the grassroots support as we held the establishment party bosses accountable.

Throughout my campaign, I have been steadfast in my belief that the biggest issues facing our nation are the crisis of fatherlessness, the dangerous lie that America is systemically racist, the need for an amendment to the constitution to set federal spending to a fixed percentage of the GDP—otherwise government gets bigger whether Republicans or Democrats are in charge, and the need to remove the Soros-backed DAs across the country who refuse to enforce the law. The breakdown of the family structure and the absence of positive father figures in the lives of many children have far-reaching consequences for our society, including the crime wave we are currently seeing in America today. I hope that my campaign has helped shine a light on these critical issues and sparked important conversations about how we can solve them.

As I look at the path forward, and after careful consideration and consultation with my campaign team, I have made the difficult decision to suspend my campaign.

Larry Elder

Anybody who has been to a gas station knows how expensive filling up your car has become in Joe Biden's America. The reason why is obvious: The Biden Administration singlehandedly reversed our country's energy independence and rapidly began pushing the destructive green energy agenda on the American people.
So in this moment when Americans are feeling unprecedented pain at the gas pump and the grift of the climate change industry has been fully exposed, you'd think Republican governors would be doing everything they can to support the oil and gas industries in their states, right?
Well, you would be wrong.
Wyoming's "Republican" Governor Mark Gordon decided to travel to Harvard last week to give a speech to left-wing academics about how he wants to make the Cowboy State "carbon negative." That's right. The governor of a state with one of the largest oil and gas industries in America pushed for green energy at the bastion of socialist politics in America.
"Frankly, I was embarrassed," our WYFC Chairman Rep. John Bear fired back in an [interview with Fox News.](https://substack.com/redirect/4be025b9-3ef1-4975-bfb1-fb63c7e7cd62?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) "At a time when Western governors should be embracing the idea of energy independence and pushing back on the anti-American, Biden agenda, we can't afford to give an inch to the anti-fossil fuel crowd and their utopian view of green energy," he added.
The WY Freedom Caucus called on Gordon to give his Harvard speech again, except this time, do it in Wyoming with Wyoming voters in the audience. So far, the governor has ignored that invitation.
As we have said time and time again, it turns out that a lot of Republican politicians will say conservative things on the campaign trail, but will not hesitate to sell out to special interests such as the green energy lobby.
The reason we are starting State Freedom Caucuses all over America is to hold these sellout Republicans accountable and to secure red state policies that conservative voters deserve.
**The Fight For School Choice in Illinois**
Illinois Democrat Governor J.B. Pritzker, as well as the Democrat Senate Majority Leader and Speaker of the House, all send their kids to private schools. Yet this past Memorial Day weekend, Pritzker decided he wants to [sunset](https://substack.com/redirect/f006e04d-1afb-4441-9752-2c2d9d8dde9f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the only school choice program in the state.
And here's the thing: The "Invest In Kids" Program is not even financed with taxpayer-funded vouchers. It simply allows individuals to donate to private school scholarship funds and receive a tax credit of up to 75% of their donation. Since it began, [nearly 41,000](https://substack.com/redirect/dc50e340-870b-4b4f-ae08-5e315a5eec8e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) scholarships have been awarded to students from low-income and working-class families.
The teachers' unions make no secret that they want Illinois to be the first state in the Union to repeal a school choice program. But the program is very popular with voters so the Democrats are in a huge bind. Pritzker says he wants to extend the program, but as we mentioned, he wants it to sunset. And he's using zero political capital to pressure the legislature to reauthorize it. Meanwhile, the Democrats in the legislature are heavily divided on the issue.
And let's not forget the Republicans who are complicit on this issue. Dozens of Republican lawmakers currently receive donations from teachers' unions. This is why, as we reported before, the Illinois Freedom Caucus called on the Illinois Republican Party to ban Republican lawmakers from taking these donations. In fact, the only Republicans who are actively supporting the "Invest in Kids" program is the IL Freedom Caucus and their allies.
Activists from all over the state have descended on Springfield to demand their elected officials save the "Invest In Kids" program, with the Illinois Freedom Caucus [welcoming them](https://substack.com/redirect/886139b6-c559-4d90-9f02-b1809237592f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to the Capitol with open arms.
The clock, however, is ticking and the state, as well as the country, will be watching closely to see just how much Democrats are controlled by the puppet strings of the teachers' unions.
**Idaho**
The American Library Association (ALA) keeps digging its own grave. It was recently [discovered](https://substack.com/redirect/04b9cfd7-535a-4e23-9230-56ea16f39dc4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that its president - a self-described Marxist - donated to the New York Democratic Socialists who held a pro-Hamas rally last week.
The ALA is not a sleepy non-profit that merely provides innocuous guidance and training to our country's libraries. They have an aggressive agenda to socially engineer our kids by inserting socialist ideas in our libraries -- using our tax dollars to do it.
But thanks to our national coordinated efforts, more and more library associations are finally cutting ties with the ALA.
Thanks to pressure from the Idaho Freedom Caucus, Kootenai and Shoshone Counties [became](https://substack.com/redirect/59b05311-a4ec-43e3-ae75-771329fcbfa8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the latest ones to do just that. And Alabama just recently severed ties as well.
We are going to end the poisonous influence the ALA has on our libraries one county and one state at a time.
**South Carolina**
The left-wing assault on our classrooms is prevalent even in a red state like South Carolina. Pornographic books are being found in the schools of Charleston County and the school board is doing nothing to put a stop to it.
SC Freedom Caucus member Rep. Jordan Pace led a rally of parents calling for smut to be removed from the schools.

| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.

When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

| | Friend, What's _really_ spooking us this Halloween? No, it's not the new _Saw_ movie or the fear of only getting Tootsie Rolls when trick-or-treating. **It's something far scarier:** 🕸️ It's the fact that we've known for decades that **truck pollution is poisoning our communities** —especially communities of color—and that **EPA is currently falling short in protecting us.** 🕸️ It's the fact that some **truck companies** are bragging about commitments to electrify their fleets, while also **secretly lobbying against strong clean truck standards.** 🕸️ It's the fact that the **Biden administration has the power** to stand up to industry and fight for communities, but is **running out of time to do it.** [Fortunately, we can do something about these Halloween "tricks."](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5046?t=3&akid=13804%2E53494%2EqGPnRo) We're still sending signatures to EPA on our petition urging them to pass the strongest possible clean truck standards, meaning **there's still time for you to speak up for our communities and our climate.**

**Derek, it was a rough last week for Donald Trump.**[Before I cover the quick details, can you contribute $3 to help my Senate campaign reach our October fundraising deadline goal before midnight?](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2023_abs_em.EYisyV&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20231031_PM2_V1_S1&email=&amount=3&t=4&akid=4343%2E5257348%2ExjhdJB)**
His so-called “legal defense” team-turned-criminal co-defendants in the Georgia election interference case are starting to fold like a bunch of cheap suits (are you surprised?).
First went Sidney Powell.
Then, Kenneth Chesebro.
Next, Jenna Ellis.
One by one last week, they marched before the bench in a Fulton County courtroom and pled guilty. District Attorney Fani Willis has called the case against Trump and others a _**“criminal racketeering enterprise to overturn Georgia’s presidential election result**_.”
Meanwhile, Trump was seen storming out of a Manhattan courtroom after a judge fined him $10,000 for violating a gag order for intimidating courtroom staff in his civil fraud trial.

_Not so fast, Derek.

In the Republican presidential primary, _he’s absolutely running away with it._
It’s NOT close. **Trump 61%, DeSantis next closest at 11%** in one of the latest national polls. **A 50-point lead.**
It’s more likely than ever that we’ll be voting in a Biden-Trump rematch next November.
You remember 2016 just like I do, when legions of pundits wrote off a caustic, scandal-ridden, self-proclaimed billionaire as being wholly incapable of winning the presidency of the United States of America.
They were wrong. And there’s only one thing we can do — **leave absolutely no doubt that we will do everything to stop him, win this Senate race, and save our democracy.**
As the legal walls continue to close in around Trump, he will only become more dangerous, with a pliant, far-right MAGA majority in control of the House willing to do his every bidding. So we have to fight back.

name: =?utf-8?Q?Brian=20Dahle?=
subject: They can't silence me
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Brian Dahle for Lieutenant Governor 2026
body:
I will keep standing up for our values. |
---
| |
---
| Friend, I want to personally reach out and say how much I appreciate your continued support and give you a quick update. The Legislature has adjourned for 2023 and it was a busy year. I joined my Republican colleagues and [urged the Governor](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=8dd080f67c&e=f9133ea432) to hold a special session to **suspend the gas tax** , I [spoke out](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=0d799212a3&e=f9133ea432) **against raising taxes** **(ACA 1)** that would undermine **Prop 13** , and I continued to fight against dangerous policies like [**SB 94**](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=bbad8dc57a&e=f9133ea432) that would let violent criminals off the hook.

I [couldn't remain silent](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=bca961d6e4&e=f9133ea432) when it came to more **bills attacking California businesses** , and **spoke out** against measures that would force [more hospitals in California to close their doors](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=408c439e16&e=f9133ea432). I also helped [secure a victory](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=75d456022e&e=f9133ea432) in the fight to**protect children -- SB 14, a bill that I co-authored** was signed into law!!

**_I will not stop fighting for the values we hold dear. _**

Below are a few additional highlights:
* **[I supported a measure to suspend the gas tax by $1/gallon](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=447a984ba9&e=f9133ea432).**
* **[I called out the Insurance Commissioner for not fixing the homeowners' insurance crisis](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=384a340f3d&e=f9133ea432).**
* **[I successfully secured financial assistance for wildfire victims](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=cf514242bf&e=f9133ea432).**

I have lots of [videos](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=5c3e9024d8&e=f9133ea432) on my [Senate website](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=97c4d7843d&e=f9133ea432) you can take a look at.

Be sure to follow me on [Instagram](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=9efee28df9&e=f9133ea432), [Facebook](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=a17a47c842&e=f9133ea432), and [Twitter.](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=bea7f6f227&e=f9133ea432)

Together we are stronger.

With thanks,
Brian

body:
Next week, voters in Virginia will be casting their ballots in local races — and we need to do our part to turn out voters. |
#
Folks — I often say that the people closest to the work know best what will work, which is why down-ballot races are so important from coast to coast. Local legislators are members of the community who know their neighbors and how best to solve the problems they’re facing. **Next week, voters in Virginia will be casting their ballots in local races — and we need to do our part to turn out voters.** With a Republican governor in Virginia, electing down-ballot Democrats is the only way we can protect Virginia’s progressive causes, including gun safety laws, climate policy, and so much more. And when it comes to abortion access, MAGA extremists in Virginia are trying to secure total control of the state government to ban abortion. And may I point out that Johnson and our opponent David Schweikert are not much different from one another.

Schweikert, like Johnson, is in favor of a nationwide abortion ban -- with absolutely zero exceptions, even for rape or incest.

body:
Don't Get Tricked by Politicians in Costumes! |
---
| | [ ](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=13f04d73c8&e=1090c5c412)

|

| | Happy Halloween!

This is a picture from ten years ago. No, it’s not really Si, Phil, Jase and Willie in Louisiana. It’s my sons Eli, Will, Jake and me dressed like the Duck Dynasty guys in Weisenberg Township.

Today is Halloween, and it’s fun to pretend you’re somebody you’re not. But when politicians constantly try to fool you, it’s not so funny anymore.

I’m running against a Democratic opponent who emphatically proclaims her bipartisanship. Yet, when she was in the House Majority, Susan Wild voted with Joe Biden 100% of the time ([here](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=3a6aac40ef&e=1090c5c412)). That’s not bipartisanship.

Last year, Pennsylvanians elected a U.S. Senator who cultivated his image as a gritty, working-class hero from Pittsburgh. In reality, John Fetterman is a Harvard-educated businessman from an affluent suburb near York. That’s not gritty.

Why do politicians do this? Because they think you are easily fooled, and that you don’t pay attention. They know that if people understood the truth about who they are and what they stand for, they would lose their elections. So, they dress up in costumes to hoodwink the voters.

Not me. I think voters crave authenticity in their leaders and are fed up with disingenuous politicians. In fact, I’m basing my whole campaign on this premise.

I’m a military veteran, business owner, husband, and father. I’ve gained expertise in the most important issues of our time. And when I get to Washington, I'll work for safe communities, good jobs, and strong families.

We won’t agree on every issue, but I won’t dress up to earn your vote. What you see is what you get.

Even if I do look a lot like Willie Robertson.

**Keep America Free.**

_Kevin Dellicker is a husband and father who has lived in the Lehigh Valley for 40 years. He's the founder of a successful technology company and a 28-year veteran of the U.S. Armed Forces. Kevin's not running for Congress because he needs a job. He's running because he's got the experience, vision, and courage to defend our American way of life.

Neither military information nor photos of Kevin or Will in uniform imply endorsement of Kevin Dellicker for Congress by the Dept. of Defense or its particular military departments._

|
[ ](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=ab898987fc904a1fabfcf3e00ca4853c&_e=KHWvpuUCey6FWZ2Ur7RupbLduGFLDTy7dPwNQc0n8c_Ztm6CMt_dMrs4NJbLqeBOw98iO1zoWIPpR-Qc25K2CBHE0Qjh9pSB8POjwutEMhTYi3xEaTzbTFX5sthRZT5mvqrU60bR9BqIKX_n_IU6ua_cJ2ph7KINxsv28Fbzq5ES3YqvMql7j9WU8bTHv22aR_E6VuZfI4qd-jp9g4bzB2wqxZWV2DdeWyKzX3GkSqzyK1zUt3Z6T0h59fAKvZvjgg1itrdKFmtfUJ0Sukyk5coQbLmCokLWqIVBwPP0GkC36yAjOfhVAoMNOaDswEGzhdD5Gk0Q0njRhDs6g6Z-i6U6bdJLjOIdyimDw0ura5MTTtXbV2fhHbReb0uz-gNV)

Fellow American,

The most important things in life are faith, family, and freedom. That's not just a slogan, these happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I am fighting every day to preserve them.

**Faith.** Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people.

**Family.** Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way.

**Freedom.** It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I've devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress.

[**This is a simple truth:**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=ab898987fc904a1fabfcf3e00ca4853c&_e=KHWvpuUCey6FWZ2Ur7RupbLduGFLDTy7dPwNQc0n8c_Ztm6CMt_dMrs4NJbLqeBOw98iO1zoWIPpR-Qc25K2CBHE0Qjh9pSB8POjwutEMhTYi3xEaTzbTFX5sthRZT5mvqrU60bR9BqIKX_n_IU6ua_cJ2ph7KINxsv28Fbzq5ES3YqvMql7j9WU8bTHv22aR_E6VuZfI4qd-jp9g4bzB2wqxZWV2DdeWyKzX3GkSqx7lpICIPmz0THZoCsHqM85BiXx6podCpCasmvN_I2-SHd4WDZbv0WtaZu6Q4Eh_qeA5vzv43VhAaS6MQSawtoTjiYPwM98b9VPrOFHWvFOOFyPo0VnggZ4Dbn0InIh0Wnaa1EUMA4RkMGYys5dQie1) America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of world - but we cannot maintain that status if we are led by politicians who hate the very foundations that made us who we are!

[** SUPPORT MIKE JOHNSON > **](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=ab898987fc904a1fabfcf3e00ca4853c&_e=KHWvpuUCey6FWZ2Ur7RupbLduGFLDTy7dPwNQc0n8c_Ztm6CMt_dMrs4NJbLqeBOw98iO1zoWIPpR-Qc25K2CBHE0Qjh9pSB8POjwutEMhTYi3xEaTzbTFX5sthRZT5mvqrU60bR9BqIKX_n_IU6ua_cJ2ph7KINxsv28Fbzq5ES3YqvMql7j9WU8bTHv22aR_E6VuZfI4qd-jp9g4bzB2wqxZWV2DdeWyKzX3GkSqzAdGxxXmjdJmrMt0WEl0R-7SkPWpRpi1FDd35qiPYBIEA_OeLxwLgl10xnilvMAaXQRKwQt0OmKWrKSxNhezSO9Mj7CJ7ErlLJKQuY6BqQLv6wfwfbdHKRrCkcJYAM4gQ7YM8T6m0nJUpwvNHzRIHW)

Right now in America, children are being taught in many schools to be ashamed of their country and themselves. The pledge is being taken out of school because it mentions God. Free speech is being censored and silenced right before our eyes. Democrats are fighting for the right to elective abortion right up to the moment of birth. Unelected, unaccountable bureaucrats are seeking control of almost every aspect of our lives.

**This is simply un-American, and we must stop the madness.**

We must elect more leaders who make decisions based on American values with an emphasis on God, family, and country. It's the only way to preserve the blessings we have been given here.

[**Today, to continue to help lead this critical fight, I need your financial support - to restore our country and defend our values. Can you make a donation immediately?**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=ab898987fc904a1fabfcf3e00ca4853c&_e=KHWvpuUCey6FWZ2Ur7RupbLduGFLDTy7dPwNQc0n8c_Ztm6CMt_dMrs4NJbLqeBOw98iO1zoWIPpR-Qc25K2CBHE0Qjh9pSB8POjwutEMhTYi3xEaTzbTFX5sthRZT5mvqrU60bR9BqIKX_n_IU6ua_cJ2ph7KINxsv28Fbzq5ES3YqvMql7j9WU8bTHv22aR_E6VuZfI4qd-jp9g4bzB2wqxZWV2DdeWyKzX3GkSqww0dikZUWObp0HvvP6eME_RUc1nHpSoubp_EJ4tTzMH5qWAbNp27DTk5puYoGX4UthUJs5Inbob-dCfYXtnALqgWTGet1LiAOD2piZFuPednZuxUMoEktrsBcqKIklN9_WWJYASREZpEzzP0DYmjGx)

[**We simply must make a change before it 's too late.**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=ab898987fc904a1fabfcf3e00ca4853c&_e=KHWvpuUCey6FWZ2Ur7RupbLduGFLDTy7dPwNQc0n8c_Ztm6CMt_dMrs4NJbLqeBOw98iO1zoWIPpR-Qc25K2CBHE0Qjh9pSB8POjwutEMhTYi3xEaTzbTFX5sthRZT5mvqrU60bR9BqIKX_n_IU6ua_cJ2ph7KINxsv28Fbzq5ES3YqvMql7j9WU8bTHv22aR_E6VuZfI4qd-jp9g4bzB2wqxZWV2DdeWyKzX3GkSqwNV9ERYQHl1IMTa1hdRbmHMAZUaznT9pVv9ZC5ix6d0zLEiDmOs5ccSL2Ws_iDlcrLOkfzE4BwRDKxpLEXZ6Bmc14qyTZDCUNHa7IIQYv-xkX0CYvspqudRqcAUANgdfvbuuBtXU55_rX0wbCOsGBi)

I made a promise when I was first elected to do what is best for our country, and for Louisiana, and I intend to keep that promise. It's why I have been a trusted ally of President Donald Trump, who selected me for critical positions and endorsed all of my campaigns. It's also why I was elected by my colleagues to serve as Vice Chairman of the House Republican Conference - one of seven elected leadership positions for Republicans in the House - and to chair the Subcommittee on the Constitution and Civil Liberties in the prestigious Judiciary Committee.

clean_body: I believe to my core that the most important things in life are God, family, and pride in our country. These are the values that guide me and shape my life. | Fellow American, The most important things in life are faith, family, and freedom. That's not just a slogan, these happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I am fighting every day to preserve them. Faith. Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people. Family. Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way. Freedom. It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I've devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress. America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of world - but we cannot maintain that status if we are led by politicians who hate the very foundations that made us who we are! Right now in America, children are being taught in many schools to be ashamed of their country and themselves. The pledge is being taken out of school because it mentions God. Free speech is being censored and silenced right before our eyes. Democrats are fighting for the right to elective abortion right up to the moment of birth. Unelected, unaccountable bureaucrats are seeking control of almost every aspect of our lives. This is simply un-American, and we must stop the madness. We must elect more leaders who make decisions based on American values with an emphasis on God, family, and country. It's the only way to preserve the blessings we have been given here. Fellow American, we have a chance to save our country from the radical Left that is aiming to destroy it, but we're running out of time. I'm not sure what version of America we will leave to our kids if we continue down this path. I made a promise when I was first elected to do what is best for our country, and for Louisiana, and I intend to keep that promise. It's why I have been a trusted ally of President Donald Trump, who selected me for critical positions and endorsed all of my campaigns. It's also why I was elected by my colleagues to serve as Vice Chairman of the House Republican Conference - one of seven elected leadership positions for Republicans in the House - and to chair the Subcommittee on the Constitution and Civil Liberties in the prestigious Judiciary Committee. We are working in Congress every day to defend our conservative way of life and lead the fight for freedom, The path we're on currently will lead us to destruction. But that outcome is not inevitable. We still have the ability to turn this country around-- IF conscientious conservatives across America will stand up RIGHT NOW. We MUST act, and we must do so today. Thank you for all you do, and God bless. subject: What Is A Problem According To the Bible?!?
body:

## What Are Problems According To Scripture?
---
Everyday all of us face problems. _Some are BIG some are small..._ When most of us think of problems, we think of them as a **negative**. However, the Bible views problems totally different. This last WKND, I preached out of the **Book of Acts** on [Growing Pains](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=3015209.997.1.0ed0d33bf887041e96b2fcc9f72877e8) aka how problems lead to growth. I believe this message will encourage you if you are facing problems in life because if you are facing problems that actually means you are looking at your **blessing**. Watch: [Acts Pt. 24 - Growing Pains](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=3015209.998.1.d0cdecd89f5054241083842b752ca591)
---
| | [ Watch: Acts Pt. 24 - Growing Pains ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=3015209.999.1.29757dc460f1da0e02570e4b6c069312)
---
---
## What Are The "Signs Of The Times"?
---
| [ ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=3015209.1000.1.f2c81c50f6c66e6ac505329d848a98c4)
---
There is so much talk about **End Times Biblical Prophecy** with all that is happening in our world, _and rightfully so_. However, many "**YouTube Preachers** " have sown seeds of confusion into the Body of Christ concerning this area of Scripture. **I am convinced that the BEST commentary on the Bible is the Bible itself.** Therefore, on Wednesday, November 1 at 7pm CT, I will do a biblical teaching on the "**SIGNS OF THE TIMES** " followed by a **Q &A session** at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=3015209.1001.1.86db864ab632841e07e99bea2a28f98a) Tulsa. Join me for what will be a thorough study of what Scripture says about the signs to look for at the end of the age.
---
| [ ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=3015209.1002.1.d568fbf502d65830cfb5416e109435ac)
---
Recently, at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=3015209.1003.1.b0f154b4bd06c19801f443cf82054a59) Tulsa & OKC, I committed the entire sermon to explaining **End Times Biblical Prophecy** and where we are on the timeline.
I addressed **Ezekiel 38** from an in-depth perspective along with the **Israel/Hamas War** that we are witnessing.
This message I know will benefit you and help you understand what the Bible says _MUST_ take place in the **Last Days**..
Watch it here: [The End Times EXPLANIED](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=3015209.1004.1.688bd7b912a8ce3d803afaa1aa35e50b)
| | [ Watch: Ezekiel 38 ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=3015209.1005.1.36d1d1f6deb7ea934bb5ea5f750914f5)
