## New Building Updates
---
| [ ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=3015209.1006.1.0774d0768bc24865b8c1387a78c74888)
---
It has been a little over a month since we moved to our new facility and the progress has been GREAT!
**Here are the upcoming projects to look for:**
**Auditorium**
-TV's to be added throughout the auditorium for the purpose of lyrics & Bible verses
-More lighting in auditorium
**Lobby**
-New ceiling & flooring
**Restrooms**
-The men of Sheridan know what needs to be removed and replaced...
**Kids & Youth**
-Both nursery's will be complete and youth room will be updated with new carpet and layout
These are the updates that we plan to complete here in the near future.
We are doing this entire renovation on a cash basis.
Thank you for your generosity that has accomplished so much and please consider continuing to partner with us so we can get the job done!
You can give at [www.sheridan.church/give](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=3015209.1007.1.c293f4e27221ee111e46c6285726c49f)
Thank you,

name: Team Mary Peltola
subject: Mary’s here against all odds
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Democrats Win Seats PAC
body:
| _*Due to personal circumstances, Mary Peltola is not actively fundraising for herself at this time. Our hearts are with her and her family. At the same time, with the critical end-of-month deadline approaching, Team Mary is turning to our community of supporters to finish the month strong on behalf of all Alaskans.*_ **Peter, no one expected Mary to become a member of Congress. She's representing Alaska down in Washington D.C._against all odds._**

Mary grew up in communities like Kwethluk and Bethel — communities made up of large populations of Alaska Natives, and far from any major cities. An Alaska Native had never served in Congress before, but that didn't stop her from running.

**Peter, we defied the odds in 2022 when Mary became the first Alaska Native to represent our state in Congress. But now we need to defy the odds once again, because special interests are spending money to defeat her as we speak. We need your help to hold them off and _win._**

**[Can you split a $25 donation between Mary's campaign and Democrats Win Seats before midnight to help us ensure we have the resources to counter these big-money special interest attacks?>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/72555096/435649797/1478669673?amount=25&refcode=EM_NBI_dwspac_20231031_FR_peltolasplit_0_3MO_teammary_NA_NA_2.5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzkvMS84ODcwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMjFlZDc3Yy0xYzc4LWVlMTEtYjAwNC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nNeILDBb70QurqFKIceVDL_CmKbN1pefzI6yIrdJf40=)** | | ****_******[Give $25 »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/72555097/435649798/1478669673?amount=25&refcode=EM_NBI_dwspac_20231031_FR_peltolasplit_0_3MO_teammary_NA_NA_2.5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzkvMS84ODcwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMjFlZDc3Yy0xYzc4LWVlMTEtYjAwNC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nNeILDBb70QurqFKIceVDL_CmKbN1pefzI6yIrdJf40=)******_****

Peter, it's no secret that politicians are out of touch with most Americans, and in particular, most Alaskans. They often come from super-wealthy backgrounds, went to the most prestigious colleges, and rubbed all the right elbows. But Mary's journey to Congress was different.

She may have not attended an Ivy League college or self-funded her campaign, but her life experiences and challenges are similar to the ones working-class Alaskans face every day. She was the only non-millionaire in the special general election last year. And Mary will never forget those roots.

**Peter, people like you helped Mary make history in 2022, and with your support, she'll be able to prove that our working-class win was NOT a fluke. But without your support, extremists have a REAL chance of taking Alaska's House seat right out from under us.**

subject: [3X MATCH DEADLINE] Please, read this right away -- the environment is in serious jeopardy as shutdown nears
body:
__We urgently need to meet our $30,000 goal before the clock strikes midnight. |
---

|
Peter -- Earlier this month, a group of donors agreed to triple-match every contribution to LCV up to $30,000. The deadline is at 11:59pm today -- and we need your help to bring us over the finish line.

**Meeting this goal matters.** With a MAGA climate change denier now leading the U.S. House and doing Big Oil's bidding, a government shutdown is likely imminent, putting enormous pressure on Congress to reach a deal that could put the environment and our communities at risk. Republicans in the House have just voted 210-199 to sabotage the clean energy transition, mandate more dirty drilling deals, and zero out funding for environmental justice.

Negotiations with the Senate will come down to the very last second. **It 's up to us to make sure that any last-minute funding deals don't increase giveaways to fossil fuels and gut environmental protections.**

[Renew your LCV membership before MIDNIGHT TONIGHT and your gift will be triple matched -- even $5 makes a big difference.](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/Ap9dcY3_)

| | **
** **FOR IMMEDIATE REVIEW**

**Supporter Record:** Peter Willis
**MATCH STATUS:** [_TRIPLE MATCH ACTIVE_](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/Ap9dcY3_)

**Deadline:** 11:59 pm TONIGHT
**Fundraising Goal:** $30,000

**STATUS:** [Renew now -- it only takes $5 >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/Ap9dcY3_) |
---|---|---

Peter -- I really hope you'll take this opportunity to triple your impact -- because this recent vote is _only the first_ of many anti-environment bills and riders we're expecting the House to pass in the coming weeks._****_

Later this week, extreme Republican representatives in the House are returning to Washington, D.C. to vote to _**slash the EPA 's budget by 40%,**_ putting our environment and the health of our communities at risk in a major way. Their bill also slashes basic clean air and water protections and environmental justice programs and rescinds funding for critical Inflation Reduction Act programs like the Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund.

**With so much at stake, we need to get every LCV member on board right now -- and we haven't heard from you yet.**

[We urgently need to meet our $30,000 goal before the clock strikes midnight. So please, renew your LCV membership for $5 now >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/Ap9dcY3_)

Thank you for your support.

Onward,

Gene Karpinski
President
League of Conservation Voters

| Last week, I was invited to speak at the **East Clackamas Republican Women's **meeting in Gladstone. The topic? Leftist infiltrators in Oregon and their recruitment of useful tools to help destroy the Republican Party from within. There's always a distinct pattern of behavior with these bad actors. That pattern is the same state by state by state... They rely on stirring hatred to malign strong, effective conservatives. They don't focus on issues. Their game is personal destruction.

The audience had thoughtful questions and I watched them nod emphatically; they'd seen firsthand what I was talking about! (I also saw a couple folks sink lower and lower in their chairs as the evening progressed.) I can't emphasize enough the importance of vetting candidates and doing your own research on issues. Grassroots Republicans have the ability to stop these players in their tracks with simple questions like: "Really? Give me an example. Who told you that? Do you have proof of that claim?" The truth doesn't mind being questioned.

Another point: The Clackamas County GOP recognizes that Oregon's Republican women's clubs are complementary organizations, not competition. They support each other. Their chair Rick Riley attended the event to help get that message across.

I had a chance to talk a bit with Lynn Schoenfeld, the frontrunner conservative candidate for Clackamas County Sheriff. If that's your county, here's his site: [Lynn Schoenfeld for Sheriff](https://sptr.eocampaign1.com/f/a/yXaO_-l9x_EMB1z83vaf7Q~~/AAAHUQA~/RgRnI9i0P0UgM2M0MjQxNTFlNTNmZmJiNzQxOTg4NjdiYTgzODk2ZGNEJWh0dHBzOi8vd3d3LnNjaG9lbmZlbGRmb3JzaGVyaWZmLmNvbS9XBXNwY2V1QgplQLRTQWVuc3WVUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAABfYw~~).

Solomon, Vivien and I then headed back to Baker County for the **Baker County Republican Women's **evening with speaker **Myron Ebell**. I enjoy serving as first vice president for this group of ladies, and hope to have many more educational events like this in the future. We're community-minded. Proceeds from our events fund our upcoming Patriot Kids Camp.

Club president Suzan Jones introduced Myron Ebell, a Senior Fellow at the Competitive Enterprise Institute and President Trump's transition agency action team lead for the EPA in 2016 and January 2017. _(Thank you, Myron!)_ We learned more about the energy crisis being created by the Biden administration's failed policies, and updates on topics like the transfer of federally (mis)managed lands back to local levels. Myron's presentation was a hit! I also want to thank Joanna and Robyn for handling the web site and ticket sales, and the entire group for baking a table full of goodies.

body:
We can stop this scary story from becoming reality—but it will take each and every one of us.
#
Peter,
Are you ready for a scary story? A GOP Senate majority with Mitch McConnell as leader.

Peter, I need to share a story with you. When I was serving in the Middle East as an active-duty naval officer in places like Fallujah and Ramadi, I learned that "freedom" to this region, meant an imposition of Islamic, Sharia law, NOT the democracy that America has defended for generations.
---
| [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=0cfd56f2c3b647508bbab5bdfe39500e&_e=ez-I8jHV0CTH0HR0B25afHP0fhx2TkfP49bSAy9fgGAdBpu9pq7-4JMtxLmMnkwERRU-KzQmsiZmD5xQcdOFv9CiqtDSpqyCe5mnYSWCKEsTbc0xeFqo4a27oDZNRK6piaIVr49QEUJJK5Lj77mI0U-On-j_yuineWPJ0cdfKVajVJmYGBEPmo9eObjOX6HvgcLkVQwEOcd4Xjx2NCCl3jf-68zlJijIfNI6S7fztGIS1pAYClfbWllYVps-h94k_HqnDrqeG0kiXHhCEEEWeJLv_w_2A8QppK56C3_cMLk-1VlYL_HKCbLbC9UBT39xmomjncvxoIEBHrE8by2WooJrj81Y_SymX8ZXp8q6WdyxpQU61Tq7PWKFQwulFvfHA_qj338CSP1zmPTdUfGKB7ZedQ3zDVuW4FDlsQdAKI8%3D)
---
But there was one outpost in the region that was unlike the rest--one place that truly believes in freedom and one place in the region that we can count on. That was the State of Israel. **Israel is our ally --it's the birthplace of Judeo-Christian values and Western civilization, and the ground where Jesus walked. We have great economic ties, we have cultural affinity, and have trust with Israel. But we are watching Joe Biden shower the terrorists that have thrown Israel into its darkest hour with millions of dollars of your money. ** I am taking this personally, and so is my state. We are sending pallets full of donated medical supplies, children's toys, clothing, and critical equipment from the State of Florida and continuing to deploy planes to bring stranded Americans home. I am fed up with Joe Biden's failure. We are acting, and I would do the same as President.
---

Peter, we know that Israel has a tough neighborhood. And after seeing the atrocity in that region firsthand, I believe the least we can do is give them support as they stand for what's right. We need a President who believes this too, and I am stepping up to be that leader. subject: A more personal message
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Upset The Setup PAC
body:
| Peter—

This is a more personal message than you generally receive from a campaign, but I wanted to pull back the curtain a bit why I’m in this race, and what the result will mean for our country.

The last few years have been grueling for our nation and our democracy, but it hasn’t always been like this.

There was a time before Donald Trump. When you could disagree without being disagreeable. When it wasn’t taboo to have friends across the aisle, or at least people you could work with. When you would bring people together — Democrats and Republicans — to get things done.

Why? Because it was in the best interest of the American people to have a government that functioned. And that wasn’t in chaos 24/7.

Those days feel long gone now. We have seen a seismic shift in the last few years — since a charlatan celebrity and reality TV host who called disabled veterans “suckers” and “losers,” denigrated our immigrant communities, and railed on about “fake news” was elected President of the United States.

I’ve never been one to back down from the bad guys — so amidst these attacks, I did my duty and called him out. I took on these fights not because they were easy, but because it needed to be done.

That vitriol has taken a turn for the worse. Here’s what the other side has had to say about me:

“Wild-eyed conspiracy nut.” - Tucker Carlson
“Pencil neck. Shifty Schiff.” - Donald Trump
“[He] openly lied to the American public.” - Kevin McCarthy

Never in my life would I expect to be cast a president’s “favorite” enemy — but here we are. And I’m not going to back down.

Derek — In
just a moment, [ https://go.tonyevers.com/go/2172?amount=10&refcode=EM_NBI_TE_20231031_FR_eom_0_3MO_TammyBaldwin_TammyBaldwin_NA_eom.3.12&t=1001&akid=6471%2E1827488%2ERh2z8n ]I’m going to ask you to split a donation between my
campaign and Tony Evers' team. But before I do, I hope you’ll take a few
minutes to let me explain why your support matters so much in a race like
ours.

Our campaign is preparing to face a flood of GOP spending in Wisconsin.
The NRSC has hand-picked two megamillionaires who have pledged to spend up
to $20 million out of their own pockets to defeat me.

That much cash could break the record for the most personal wealth any
candidate has ever spent in Wisconsin — and it gets worse... Neither of my
potential wealthy opponents are officially in the race yet, but they are
campaigning in secret to skirt around FEC disclosure rules and avoid
answering questions about their personal wealth and radical agendas — all
to put our campaign at a huge financial disadvantage.

It’s the same playbook Ron Johnson used to flip Wisconsin’s other Senate
seat from blue to red: get in late, pour millions of dollars into the
race, and then win a narrow victory.

We cannot let that happen again. But the only way to ensure our campaign
has the resources to fight back against the colossal amount of GOP
spending coming our way is for us to hit every one of our fundraising

body:
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=673%2E791427%2EyoGSij)

Friend,
This past weekend, Israel opened what Prime Minister Netanyahu has called a "new phase" in its war in Gaza, by sending in ground troops and expanding its assault on all fronts as it begins a ground invasion.
I cannot overstate this, and I want to be perfectly clear: this ground invasion will have disastrous, unspeakable consequences, and will lead to loss of life on a catastrophic scale.
**We must oppose this Israeli ground invasion, and unequivocally demand an immediate ceasefire in Gaza.**
Hamas’s attacks have killed over 1,400 Israelis. And since October 7, Israeli air strikes have killed over 8,000 Palestinians. Fuel and electricity remain shut off, and the 2.3 million residents of Gaza remain trapped in what is the world's largest open-air prison.
Civilians in Gaza have been told to evacuate and re-locate, and with no options for meaningfully doing so, are bombarded with airstrikes while fleeing. The Gaza health care system is now in a state of "complete collapse”, according to the Health Ministry.
No country should be allowed to massacre civilians, cut off access to water, food, fuel, electricity, and any means of communication to civilians — in direct violation of international law — with impunity.
Amidst the horror in Israel and Gaza, 13 entire communities have been displaced from their land in the occupied West Bank. At least seven Palestinians have been murdered by Israeli settlers, according to Israeli human rights group Bt’Selem.
The US must use all diplomatic tools to put a stop to this violence. We must ask a simple question: What is the endgame here?
Does it increase security or safety for Israelis and Palestinians? It does not.
Even beyond the question of basic morality, it is important to note that this war is deeply unpopular, here at home and across the world.
Two-thirds of Americans and 80% of Democrats support a ceasefire. A majority of the Israeli people oppose a ground invasion. In the past few weeks I have been heartened to see Jewish-Americans lead peaceful protests and sit-ins calling for peace and an end to this conflict. I have also been heartened by the solidarity between the Muslim and Jewish communities in my district and across the country, making clear that our opposition to this war goes hand in hand with opposition to antisemitism and Islamophobia.
The solution to this horror, as ever, is a negotiated peace with Israelis and Palestinians enjoying equal rights, protections, and security guarantees.
As someone who has experienced firsthand the trauma of war, I know that at times such peace can feel impossible to imagine. But it all starts with all of us demanding an immediate ceasefire, for the release of hostages by Hamas, for the international community to demand accountability for these crimes.
Most of all, we must remember that each of us is part of one human family, as we continue to fight for peace and justice across the globe.
Thank you for reading.
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar

body:

Hi, friend, it's Wendy Davis. I'm going to ask you to support my good friend Colin Allred's campaign to defeat Ted Cruz. But first, let me tell you why Colin is the steady leader we need in the Senate:
I first met Colin when he worked as the DFW Regional Voter Protection Director for my campaign in 2014.
Here's the thing about Colin : What you see is what you get – Colin is a community servant before all else. I knew from the day I hired him (almost 10 years ago!) that he would do everything in his power to make sure Texans have every opportunity to succeed.
That's why I was so proud to endorse him in 2018 when he decided to run for Congress and defied all odds to defeat a 22-year Republican incumbent.
And it's why I'm thrilled to support Colin again now. He can defeat Ted Cruz if we give him the resources he needs to reach voters across Texas. That's why I'm personally asking you to support him, too. Please, will you split a donation of $15, or any amount, between Colin and Serve America to help Colin send Ted Cruz packing once and for all? → [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-allred]
I'm sure I don't need to convince you how terrible Ted Cruz has been for Texans.
His attacks on our reproductive freedom and LGBTQ+ rights, his outrageous book ban, his irresponsible trip to Cancun while a winter storm caused power outages across the state ... I could go on and on, but the long and short of it is this: We need a new senator, and Colin Allred is the real deal.
Experts agree Texas is winnable. FiveThirtyEight called it Democrats' best pickup opportunity in 2024, and CNN says Cruz is the most vulnerable Republican senator on the ballot. All we need is a powerful, Texas-sized grassroots movement made up of passionate supporters like you, friend.
So please, will you join me by splitting a donation of any amount between Colin's campaign and Serve America today? Colin needs to raise $25,190 by midnight, and I promised we'd help him get there. Every dollar gets us that much closer to defeating Ted Cruz → [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-allred]
I promise you won't regret this,
Wendy Davis

| | | Peter, Last week, hundreds of WFP members came together for a national phone bank urging your members of Congress to support a ceasefire in Gaza. **And volunteers and supporters like you helped make it one of our most successful phone banks ever, with over 18,000 calls in just two hours on a Wednesday afternoon.** Over the last month, thousands of Palestinians and Israelis have been killed, and hundreds of thousands of Palestinians have been displaced. With an Israeli ground invasion of Gaza underway, it’s more important than ever that we demand our members of Congress support an immediate de-escalation and ceasefire. **[So tomorrow, Wednesday, November 1 at 3 PM ET/12 PM PT, we’ll be making calls again helping voters reach their representatives to call for humanitarian aid and a ceasefire in Gaza NOW. clean_body: | | | Peter, Last week, hundreds of WFP members came together for a national phone bank urging your members of Congress to support a ceasefire in Gaza. And volunteers and supporters like you helped make it one of our most successful phone banks ever, with over 18,000 calls in just two hours on a Wednesday afternoon. Over the last month, thousands of Palestinians and Israelis have been killed, and hundreds of thousands of Palestinians have been displaced. With an Israeli ground invasion of Gaza underway, it’s more important than ever that we demand our members of Congress support an immediate de-escalation and ceasefire. The number of Palestinian civilians killed by Israeli military strikes is growing by the day. The people of Gaza are struggling to survive amidst a lack of food, water, electricity, and medical supplies, with several hospitals destroyed or forced to evacuate. The situation will only get worse if our leaders don’t stand up and demand a ceasefire and the delivery of humanitarian aid to the people of Gaza, in order to save as many lives as possible. WFP champions in Congress have shown the courage to lead this effort, with Rep. Cori Bush’s Ceasefire Now resolution earning support from Rep. Pramila Jayapal, Rep. Barbara Lee, Rep. Summer Lee, Rep. Greg Casar, Rep. Maxwell Frost, Rep. Jamaal Bowman, Rep. Delia Ramirez, and more. But so many other representatives need to hear from their constituents before they decide whether to support this absolutely necessary ceasefire. In solidarity, Working Families Party Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. If you received this email as a forward and want to get the latest updates from the Working Families Party directly, The Working Families Party is the party of the multiracial working class, fighting for a nation that cares for all of us. body:
| | | | | [](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2088605?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---|---|---

| | There’s a _**spooky, eerie**_ feeling in the air. _**Mangled corpses**_ and fragments of body parts covered in _**pools of blood and guts.**_ **Murder, massacre, mayhem.** In the distance, the fearful cries of _**innocent younglings**_ echo across the night. The _**violent killer**_ lurks among the trees, _stalking the forest for more prey to slaughter._ This terrifying tale isn’t from Texas Chainsaw Massacre or any other Halloween horror film for that matter. _**Then, who is the murderer in the gruesome scene we just described?**_ _A trophy hunter._ Trophy hunters are _savagely killing_ innocent gray wolves and grizzly bears at record numbers, using some of the _**most horrific hunting methods**_ imaginable and leaving behind graphic scenes that are as gory as the one above. If we’re going to SAVE helpless wolf pups and grizzly cubs from being _**BRUTALIZED TO DEATH**_ by trophy hunters, we MUST demand stronger federal protections for these defenseless animals. [_**Will you take action now and be a voice for grizzly bears and gray wolves before trophy hunters wipe these iconic species out forever?**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2088606?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2088607?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
_Choked to death by a metal snare. Limbs and body crushed by steel traps. Chased down to exhaustion then run over by a snowmobile that is far too powerful and fast to physically outrun. Dynamited and blown to pieces while asleep at home. Bombarded with dozens of sharp bullets piercing through your skin and organs. _
_It probably goes without saying that these are all tortuous and inhumane ways to die._ _**Literal nightmare fuel.**_ But sadly, helpless gray wolves and grizzly bears often live this nightmare as their reality when they are forced to suffer gruesome deaths at the hands of blood-thirsty trophy hunters.
Protecting two of North America’s most treasured native **keystone species** should be a federal environmental priority for the sake of biodiversity and a balanced ecosystem that impacts us all. But instead, extremist politicians and Big Polluters are conspiring to actually _**REMOVE**_ life-saving Endangered Species Act (ESA) protections for grizzly bears and gray wolves.
Without bold ESA safeguards in place, gray wolves and grizzly bears barely have a chance at survival against rampant trophy hunters — and time is running out to speak up for these beloved animals. **_That’s why we’re urgently calling on 3,107 more environmentalists like you to speak up by 11:59 PM tonight._ [_TAKE ACTION: Demand stronger ESA protections for gray wolves and grizzly bears NOW! >>_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2088608?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**[_ _](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2088608?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

Without bold ESA safeguards in place, gray wolves and grizzly bears barely have a chance at survival against rampant trophy hunters — and time is running out to speak up for these beloved animals. That’s why we’re urgently calling on 3,107 more environmentalists like you to speak up by 11:59 PM tonight. == == Thanks for being a voice for vulnerable species, Friends of the Earth | Contact Us: Friends of the Earth U.S. Washington, D.C. | Berkeley, CA 1-877-843-8687 foe.org/about-us/contact/

Let me explain how I came to this decision because it wasn't an easy one.

For me — this fight and this campaign have always been personal. My dad spent 25 years as a police officer and growing up, my family taught me I had a responsibility to make a difference when I could. In Ferguson, Missouri, that meant trying to help calm tensions between police and protesters.

**Public service is in my DNA** , and that means being willing to take on tough fights. In 2018, that meant running against a seven-term incumbent for the St. Louis County prosecutor's office and winning.

subject: Mike Johnson supported expunging Trump’s impeachment.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTEVETS, VOTEVETS
body:
Reporting Donald Trump’s corruption and testifying in that impeachment inquiry cost me my military career.
#
Derek,
It’s Alex Vindman. Most of you know that I’m an Army Veteran. And most of you know who I am because of Trump’s first impeachment trial.
I testified before the House of Representatives, and told them the truth about Trump’s corrupt call with President Zelenskyy. I reported that Trump withheld critical Military aid to force President Zelenskyy to open a baseless, politically motivated investigation against Joe Biden.
Trump attacked me viciously, as did many Republicans in Congress and in the media.
Reporting Donald Trump’s corruption and testifying in that impeachment inquiry cost me my Military career. But if I had to do it all over again, I would. Because doing the right thing matters in a country like ours.
The man who is now Speaker of the House supported expunging Trump’s impeachment. Mike Johnson.
I will not sit idly by as he and a Congress led by the most extreme wing of the Republican Party drive their extreme partisan agenda, while they whitewash history and AGAIN imperil aid for Ukraine. I am doubling down on my commitment to send each and every radical Republican into political retirement.
VoteVets is leading the fight to take back the House, and I’m proud to support their efforts.
[**That’s why I am asking you to make a donation to VoteVets today. Make that donation before their end-of-month deadline at midnight tonight. $5 or whatever you can afford.](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-oct23.zemByr&refcode=em231031-1-30&t=1&akid=18255%2E3013755%2ETuBjcP)**

Friend,

It’s the “scariest” time of the year.

And I am not talking about goblins, skeletons, and tombstones but the prospect of another Biden term in the White House and the Democrats taking control of Congress.

_**That is not just scary but downright frightening.**_

But when you add Bidenomics, more woke lawlessness, and an uncontrolled border, then it feels like a nightmare that will never end.

It is time to stop the liberals’ “tricks.” It is time to bring common sense and sound judgment to Congress, and with your help, we can do it.

Please help our campaign at the end of the month. I know many of you are part of our “$5 Friday” club, but to be honest, our campaign needs a bit more. Hello...

This could be the last email I ever send you, Friend.

But I have to be honest with you -- no matter how weary I am about opening up.

**Right now, the odds are stacked against us, and I need to know how you 'll react to this email to understand how to move forward. Your response could change everything.**

My name is Jim Banks. If you haven't heard of me, I'm an Afghanistan veteran from Indiana now serving in Congress.

I worked hard to serve my community alongside my wife, Amanda. And above all, I am a father to three amazing girls.

Given that, and the truly *insane* price of pre-made costumes, we spent an afternoon hitting Michael’s and glue-gunning and puffy-painting away. It was an awesome day, and here is the end product:

| Friend,
**I went inside the US Capitol on January 6, 2021...** to support President Trump and stand up for fair elections in this country.
I was sentenced to**30 days in federal prison** on a petty misdemeanor charge for “picketing” because of it.
(10 of those days, I even spent in solitary confinement, because I refused to take the Covid shot.)
**But I don’t regret one single minute of it,** because I know that standing for what’s right is ALWAYS the right thing to do...no matter what.
I’m running for Congress because I think our nation would be a hell of a lot better off if politicians in Washington _actually stood with and stood by their principles._
My name is Chuck Hand and I’m writing to you today because **[I’ve been told you’re the kind of person who’s always ready to help a real conservative fight for this country.](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8kM2OnDAQhJ-muYFMm98Dh03Q5JTjrnJDHrsN1vgHGTujefsIMsm16lNVdQu3W6NfE_TfAHEz6gBE4B-AmBP_Ep-fP-Or_Hj-Kn-0X7ieJn4HxPTa6T_5DqnICWNPtZ8LNTUoai0LmupuHPph7HldbNPYDqrtWNOSvDMmFZM9jg1DyQQbJWJhJmTIa8ZrRFbzvlId19STGMZuVPw-QMOuokpHorQZ_6CohLGvSgZX2GlLaT-uYTfA20EyR6qexkdSJwF4k1uWj3ITXpU6xHKlEFcjLkOviwp-CW7RSS30u7S-Xe5x-bcJ-C2eidH4FficYibATriQfQI-YwvY5eSWI-QoCfjspX1LjpTJDvh8j29FCrcLs3rg89-m62qG_O0niievk6qLOKn9aaw1R9dDw9brAzK4PwEAAP__P2aMRA)**
**[Could you pitch in just a couple bucks to help me launch my campaign for Congress...](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8kM2OnDAQhJ-muYFMm98Dh03Q5JTjrnJDHrsN1vgHGTujefsIMsm16lNVdQu3W6NfE_TfAHEz6gBE4B-AmBP_Ep-fP-Or_Hj-Kn-0X7ieJn4HxPTa6T_5DqnICWNPtZ8LNTUoai0LmupuHPph7HldbNPYDqrtWNOSvDMmFZM9jg1DyQQbJWJhJmTIa8ZrRFbzvlId19STGMZuVPw-QMOuokpHorQZ_6CohLGvSgZX2GlLaT-uYTfA20EyR6qexkdSJwF4k1uWj3ITXpU6xHKlEFcjLkOviwp-CW7RSS30u7S-Xe5x-bcJ-C2eidH4FficYibATriQfQI-YwvY5eSWI-QoCfjspX1LjpTJDvh8j29FCrcLs3rg89-m62qG_O0niievk6qLOKn9aaw1R9dDw9brAzK4PwEAAP__P2aMRA)** and help me _finally_ give a real voice to the working men and women that make up this nation?
**[Donate here if you can. A couple bucks would be a huge help.](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8kM2OnDAQhJ-muYFMm98Dh03Q5JTjrnJDHrsN1vgHGTujefsIMsm16lNVdQu3W6NfE_TfAHEz6gBE4B-AmBP_Ep-fP-Or_Hj-Kn-0X7ieJn4HxPTa6T_5DqnICWNPtZ8LNTUoai0LmupuHPph7HldbNPYDqrtWNOSvDMmFZM9jg1DyQQbJWJhJmTIa8ZrRFbzvlId19STGMZuVPw-QMOuokpHorQZ_6CohLGvSgZX2GlLaT-uYTfA20EyR6qexkdSJwF4k1uWj3ITXpU6xHKlEFcjLkOviwp-CW7RSS30u7S-Xe5x-bcJ-C2eidH4FficYibATriQfQI-YwvY5eSWI-QoCfjspX1LjpTJDvh8j29FCrcLs3rg89-m62qG_O0niievk6qLOKn9aaw1R9dDw9brAzK4PwEAAP__P2aMRA)**

I’d say they’re treating me like a joke...that they don’t _really_ think a guy who works in construction in one of the poorest districts in America has a snowball’s chance in hell...
**_...but they know better._**
After the last few years of conservative wins,**they _absolutely_ believe a Trump-loving, conservative-thinking “deplorable” like me can win. ** That’s why they’re already firing everything they’ve got at me. | | | | [STAND WITH ME IN THIS FIGHT!](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8kM2OnDAQhJ-muYFMm98Dh03Q5JTjrnJDHrsN1vgHGTujefsIMsm16lNVdQu3W6NfE_TfAHEz6gBE4B-AmBP_Ep-fP-Or_Hj-Kn-0X7ieJn4HxPTa6T_5DqnICWNPtZ8LNTUoai0LmupuHPph7HldbNPYDqrtWNOSvDMmFZM9jg1DyQQbJWJhJmTIa8ZrRFbzvlId19STGMZuVPw-QMOuokpHorQZ_6CohLGvSgZX2GlLaT-uYTfA20EyR6qexkdSJwF4k1uWj3ITXpU6xHKlEFcjLkOviwp-CW7RSS30u7S-Xe5x-bcJ-C2eidH4FficYibATriQfQI-YwvY5eSWI-QoCfjspX1LjpTJDvh8j29FCrcLs3rg89-m62qG_O0niievk6qLOKn9aaw1R9dDw9brAzK4PwEAAP__P2aMRA)

They know that, when I make it to Washington, I’m going to be the biggest headache they’ve ever seen...

...because I’ll force the Establishment to **look straight in the eye** with the American majority they’ve been screwing over for decades.

They don’t want you to have a voice, ever again. **I _refuse_ to be silent.**

**So, as we enjoy the Halloween spirit tonight, can you make a contribution of $5, $50, or any amount you can spare to support our campaign? You can chip in with this link:

| | | **Let 's Make Washington's 8th Safer: Support Our Police & Combat Crime****
**
---

Dear Peter,
Safety and security in our homes and streets is paramount. In Washington's 8th legislative district, we've seen the challenges posed by rising crime. It's a reality we must address head-on.
Our campaign is at the forefront of supporting our police – the brave men and women who risk their lives to keep us safe – and implementing strategies to combat crime effectively.
Endorsements from local law enforcement agencies and community leaders have reinforced our mission. But, the real strength comes from supporters like you.

---
| | | |
---
| Can you contribute $25, $50, or $100 today to back our blue and make Washington's 8th a safer place for all?
Your contribution will:

* Enhance resources and training for our police officers.
* Ensure stronger enforcement of the law.
* Provide people with opportunities for a successful life away from crime.

---

Sincerely,

Carmen Goers

I realize this number might sound humble, but I want to explain why your donation today matters so much.
#
$5.
While that number might sound humble, Derek, it's the exact amount I'm asking you to please chip in before our deadline at midnight tonight to support my work and protect our seat in the Senate.
**Why $5, you might ask?** 🤔 Because, while one single donation of $5 may not sound like a lot on its own, someone else reading this email today might just step up to join you in donating $5 too. And then all those gifts of $5 will start to add up.

John ❤️

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

After weeks of chaos, Ken Calvert and 219 other House Republicans voted to elect one of the most extreme Speakers in United States history.

| Peter,

It takes two long years of raising a little bit here and there to have the resources we need to wage a competitive campaign. It’s unfortunate but true. So we need you. To hit our $15,000 goal, we’ve just got to raise $1,945 in these final hours. So, please: Let’s not let Chrissy down. Can you rush a $5 donation right now to power Chrissy’s important work through 2024 and beyond? In a race this important, every donation matters. | | = Thank you, Michelle Dorothy, Chief Political Advisor Chrissy Houlahan for Congress | Chrissy Houlahan for Congress P.O. | Friend, it is the honor of a lifetime to serve as the 56th Speaker of the House. I’m humbled that my Republican colleagues in the House united behind me as the next Republican Speaker, and I owe everyone who voted for them a debt of gratitude. It’s a debt I intend to repay by being the best servant leader I can be. The Speaker’s gavel is a solemn responsibility, especially in a time like this when the course of history will be set by our actions over the next year. I relied on my faith in God each day before I was Speaker, and I’ll continue to do so each day after. **Scripture is very clear: God is the one who raises those up in authority.** _**I believe that each one of us in Congress has a huge responsibility, to use the gifts that God has given us to serve the people of this great country, for one simple reason; they deserve it.**_ I’m determined to save our country from the powers which seek to destroy it, but I cannot do that alone.

I’m humbly asking patriots to unite together in our common cause of protecting and preserving the Constitution for generations to come and reigniting the promise of America for every citizen of this great country. **[Right now, I’m focused on getting Republicans back to work on the promises we made to voters, but I also desperately need to boost my fundraising so we can not only maintain, but grow our conservative majority.](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8kDGPnDAQhX_N0IFgbGApKJKQTREpRbpUyGsPrE8M5gZb6P59BNlc-94nf89jeFv89NFD-xUQn97tgAjqCyC-_zlY0hv__JF_b37n780vrs8SvwFi_Njok3w9UhAbv5xpO2SuV5MrdUZ91XS3tlOqxezZO9u5mupbTbUjNRmNaKqOrDKdpqpuM99jiaoqVYWqrHRdlLqlm9MWtWvU1E2gy8tTGCbx1lR7PIxICFzYwNnSP2Pc9mvYHfC-k01CxeFXIXcSgPdnSDvlc9jyh4lxoVlCWl0-pdWd7fyYRhfWMfBIMvJbzjTKPv7bhS2ou-GQ1ghqqEvARk6F-HUGNURJBNikyOMeklgCNWxRXhGT84lBDY__iTW8GT-voIZLdH28RPWqI8mJH4KZ9G47_LL4vWlBl_N1Axv4bwAAAP__VBKOPg) **
| [ **DONATE NOW** ](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8kDGPnDAQhX_N0IFgbGApKJKQTREpRbpUyGsPrE8M5gZb6P59BNlc-94nf89jeFv89NFD-xUQn97tgAjqCyC-_zlY0hv__JF_b37n780vrs8SvwFi_Njok3w9UhAbv5xpO2SuV5MrdUZ91XS3tlOqxezZO9u5mupbTbUjNRmNaKqOrDKdpqpuM99jiaoqVYWqrHRdlLqlm9MWtWvU1E2gy8tTGCbx1lR7PIxICFzYwNnSP2Pc9mvYHfC-k01CxeFXIXcSgPdnSDvlc9jyh4lxoVlCWl0-pdWd7fyYRhfWMfBIMvJbzjTKPv7bhS2ou-GQ1ghqqEvARk6F-HUGNURJBNikyOMeklgCNWxRXhGT84lBDY__iTW8GT-voIZLdH28RPWqI8mJH4KZ9G47_LL4vWlBl_N1Axv4bwAAAP__VBKOPg)

There are dozens of highly competitive battleground seats that we must win in 2024, or Hakeem Jeffries will take the Speaker's Gavel and immediately go back to business as usual on January 4th, 2025. **Saving our country from the Radical Left is not a small task, and it will require an overwhelming effort from grassroots conservatives from every county in every state.** [**If you’re able, I’d be humbled to have your support.**](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8kDGPnDAQhX_N0IFgbGApKJKQTREpRbpUyGsPrE8M5gZb6P59BNlc-94nf89jeFv89NFD-xUQn97tgAjqCyC-_zlY0hv__JF_b37n780vrs8SvwFi_Njok3w9UhAbv5xpO2SuV5MrdUZ91XS3tlOqxezZO9u5mupbTbUjNRmNaKqOrDKdpqpuM99jiaoqVYWqrHRdlLqlm9MWtWvU1E2gy8tTGCbx1lR7PIxICFzYwNnSP2Pc9mvYHfC-k01CxeFXIXcSgPdnSDvlc9jyh4lxoVlCWl0-pdWd7fyYRhfWMfBIMvJbzjTKPv7bhS2ou-GQ1ghqqEvARk6F-HUGNURJBNikyOMeklgCNWxRXhGT84lBDY__iTW8GT-voIZLdH28RPWqI8mJH4KZ9G47_LL4vWlBl_N1Axv4bwAAAP__VBKOPg) _In Liberty,_ Speaker Mike Johnson

ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
Of all the spooky and scary things on display this Halloween, there may be none scarier than what is happening in the House of Representatives.
Over the last week, we learned more about the new Speaker of the House, whose demeanor may mask the cruelty of his policy positions. I feel sure you have read lots of articles about his past statements and present positions. This week, we are starting to see his approach to his new role, and to governing in general. And it is scary. It jeopardizes not only keeping our government funded and functioning, but also our standing in the world and our support for democracy worldwide.
We already knew that the stakes for the 2024 elections could not be higher. What we have seen in recent weeks is merely a preview. And that’s why I am writing now—because we have to work every day from now to next November to make sure that we change the course we are on.
And on our course, we are hitting another marker along our path: the end-of-October fundraising deadline. Every day from now to next November, we will be working to hold on to this seat, win back the House, elect a new Senator from Texas, and hold on to the White House.
I know from experience that we can meet this moment and change the course we’re on. But we can only do it when we all show up in every way we can.
That’s why your response to these deadlines and your generous contributions are so meaningful. Your support makes everything our team does between now and Election Day possible. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe231031?refcode=lpfe231031]
